Third, this geometric narrowing does not imply functional redundancy: adding later experts improves next-token prediction in 24 of 39 frozen-route comparisons, while the other 15 estimates are inconclusive; a controlled training study also favors Top-2 over Top-1 in all three seeds. We call this joint pattern coherent overlap: routing selects token-relevant experts from a shared geometric neighborhood, while useful multi-expert computation persists without disjoint linear coverage. Separating these quantities clarifies why geometric similarity alone cannot determine redundancy or pruning value.

</details>


### [275] [Measuring Distortion in the Empty Regions of Dimensionality Reduction Scatterplots with the Gap Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28324)
*Jaume Ros,Alessio Arleo,Fernando Paulovich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Gap Index (GI)质量度量，通过度量投影中空白区域的形变来捕捉视觉失真，与仅关注点间关系的传统度量互补，可快速计算且可解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的降维投影质量度量主要关注点之间的直接关系（如距离或邻域），忽略了布局空白区域中的失真。然而这些空白区域通常构成2D布局中视觉上显著的特征，因此需要一种能够捕捉空白区域空间形变的质量度量。

Method: 将投影空间分解为空三角形（empty triangles），将每个三角形的变形与其高维空间中的对应三角形进行比较，计算每三角形的变形量。这些逐三角形变形值可以聚合成单一标量值，也可以叠加在投影上以可视化区域失真模式。

Result: 与主流质量度量相比，GI对具有高视觉影响的小型结构形变敏感；同时计算速度快且结果可解释。

Conclusion: GI是一种有效的补充性质量度量，能够捕捉传统指标遗漏的空白区域视觉失真，为高维数据投影的视觉分析提供更全面的质量评估工具。

Abstract: Quality metrics play a crucial role in the proper use of dimensionality reduction projections for visual analysis of high-dimensional data. They quantify the degree of distortion of a projection compared to the high-dimensional data and provide a reliable indication of how confident users can be in the structures they see in the resulting layouts. However, most popular metrics focus on capturing direct relationships between points (e.g., distances or neighborhoods) while neglecting distortions in empty areas of the layout, even though these often compose visually relevant features of a 2D layout. In this paper, we introduce the Gap Index (GI), a quality metric for 2D projections that captures visual distortion by measuring spatial distortion in empty areas of a projection. It does so by decomposing the space into empty triangles, which are then compared to their high-dimensional counterparts to compute the deformation. This per-triangle deformation can be aggregated into a single scalar value or overlaid on a projection to visualize regional distortion patterns. Results show that, contrary to popular quality metrics, the GI is sensitive to small structural deformations that have high visual impact. It is also fast to compute and interpretable.

</details>


### [276] [LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28374)
*Enjun Du,Hange Zhou,Chenxu Du,Siyi Liu,Zirong Chen,Ziyu Zheng,Yongqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LedgerMind，一种将多模态智能体轨迹视为受来源约束的状态机的方法，通过结构化证据账本、三层接地协议、自适应双路径调度器和事件触发验证与修复引擎，同时提升最终答案准确率和轨迹级忠实度，解决仅以最终答案准确率评估无法揭示推理过程问题（如虚假接地、过度推理、修复放大等）的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多模态智能体在视觉问答中的评估仅关注最终答案准确率，无法区分正确回答是通过有依据的证据推理、语言先验还是错误的误差抵消获得的。这种聚合信号掩盖了推理过程中产生的问题，如中间推理缺乏支撑、实体级幻觉、简单查询的过度推理以及修复时的信息放大。

Method: 将智能体轨迹建模为来源约束的状态机：工具输出被规范化到结构化证据账本中作为轨迹状态，下游推理和决策声明只能引用活跃账本条目；在实体和数值层面检查接地性；修复过程通过类型化状态转换实现，不能引入无工具来源证明的内容。此外，设计了三层接地协议、自适应双路径调度器（根据问题复杂度匹配推理深度）以及事件触发验证与修复引擎，后者带有形式化的来源非放大保证。

Result: 在多个多模态推理基准和多种骨干多模态大语言模型上的实验表明，LedgerMind同时提升了答案准确率和轨迹级忠实度。

Conclusion: 通过将来源约束、结构化证据管理和有保证的修复机制引入多模态智能体推理轨迹，可以在提高最终答案正确性的同时确保推理过程的可追溯性和可信度，为多模态智能体评估提供超越最终答案准确率的更全面标准。

Abstract: Multimodal agents for visual question answering increasingly operate as multi-step trajectories that interleave perception, retrieval, and reasoning, yet evaluation still largely reduces to final-answer accuracy. This aggregate signal cannot tell whether a correct answer was reached through grounded evidence, language priors, or accidental error cancellation. We propose to treat a multimodal agent trajectory as a provenance-constrained state machine: tool outputs are normalized into a Structured Evidence Ledger that serves as the trajectory state, downstream reasoning and decision claims may cite only active ledger entries, grounding is checked at the entity and numeric level, and repair is realized as typed state transitions that cannot introduce content without tool-produced provenance. We instantiate this design as LedgerMind (Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger), augmented by a Three-Layer Grounding Protocol, an Adaptive Dual-Path Dispatcher that matches reasoning depth to question complexity, and an Event-Triggered Verification-and-Repair engine with a formal provenance non-amplification guarantee. We use LedgerMind to target four recurring failure patterns that final-answer accuracy tends to obscure: unsupported intermediate reasoning, citation-backed entity hallucination (Phantom Grounding), over-reasoning on simple queries, and repair-time amplification. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks and backbone MLLMs show that LedgerMind improves both answer accuracy and trajectory-level faithfulness.

</details>


### [277] [Hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo for Order-Optimal Neural Actor-Critic in Average-Reward CMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28390)
*Ankur Naskar,Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次为带神经评论家的平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）建立了阶最优收敛保证（$\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$），通过引入分层多级蒙特卡洛（MLMC）神经评论家来克服批评家偏差与优化成本之间的基本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管带线性评论家的原始-对偶Actor-Critic方法已被充分理解，但将阶最优收敛保证扩展到平均奖励CMDP中的神经评论家仍是一个未解问题。核心挑战在于神经核（NTK）分析下存在批评家偏差与优化成本之间的基本权衡：降低偏差会大幅增加优化成本，阻碍原始-对偶框架中的阶最优收敛。

Method: 提出一种分层多级蒙特卡洛（MLMC）神经评论家，在轨迹采样与评论家优化两个维度同时进行去偏。该估计器仅以对数的期望样本代价即可达到长评论家优化运行的偏差水平。在此基础上，开发了一种原始-对偶自然Actor-Critic算法。

Result: 算法实现了最优性差距和约束违反量均为$\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$的阶最优收敛保证，并且无需知道底层混合时间。这是无限时域平均奖励CMDP在一般策略参数化和神经评论家下的首个阶最优收敛保证，甚至在没有约束的场景下也是新颖的。

Conclusion: 本文通过MLMC神经评论家解决了神经批评家在CMDP中的偏差-成本权衡问题，建立了首个阶最优收敛保证，推广了此前仅适用于线性评论家的理论结果，并消除了对混合时间先验知识的依赖。

Abstract: Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs) provide a natural framework for reinforcement learning in safety-critical applications, where agents maximize long-term reward while satisfying long-term constraints. Although primal-dual actor-critic methods with linear critics are well understood, extending order-optimal convergence guarantees to neural critics in average-reward CMDPs has remained open. The main challenge is a fundamental bias-cost trade-off in neural critic estimation: under Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) analysis, reducing critic bias substantially increases critic optimization cost, preventing order-optimal convergence in the primal-dual framework. We resolve this bottleneck by introducing a hierarchical Multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) neural critic that performs debiasing simultaneously across trajectory sampling and critic optimization. The resulting estimator attains the bias of a long critic optimization run with only logarithmic expected sample cost. Building on this estimator, we develop a primal-dual Natural Actor-Critic algorithm that achieves both an optimality gap and a constraint violation of order $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$. This establishes the first order-optimal convergence guarantees for infinite-horizon average-reward CMDPs with general policy parameterization and neural critics, while eliminating the need to know the underlying mixing time. Our results are novel even in the unconstrained setting.

</details>


### [278] [Why Are GUI Agents Correct but Late? Decode on the Decision-Time Critical Path, Tested with Pre-Compiled Policy Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28399)
*Zihan Dong,Rui Qian,Qishi Zhan,Dongshen Peng,Kaixin Li,Yu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自适应预期策略树（AAPT），通过利用空闲屏幕期预构建带守卫的条件策略树，消除计算机使用智能体在决策关键路径上的自回归解码延迟，在竞态决策窗口中显著提升任务成功率（0.50→0.79），且不产生错误动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机使用智能体常因瞬时GUI事件而失败，因为产生正确的动作需要昂贵的自回归解码，而解码期间相关窗口已经关闭。作者识别出核心原因是决策关键路径上的解码延迟，亟需一种在不修改底层模型的前提下消除该延迟的方案。

Method: AAPT利用空闲屏幕周期，用同一个冻结的多模态模型构建一个有界的条件策略树，包含可观测的守卫条件、预授权动作和分支专属截止时间。树的规模根据模型自身解码延迟来确定。事件发生时，轻量级观察器将变化门控的帧与预构建分支匹配，立即执行对应动作而不生成新文本。

Result: 在预注册终点和精确McNemar检验的配对试验中，AAPT将竞态决策窗口内的成功率从0.50提升到0.79（p=1.8×10^-3），且无错误动作。开放环和预测-重规划基线均为零成功率。消融实验揭示了三个关键要求：快速观察器解码、有效树规划、准确分支路由；预注册oracle探针推翻了初始假设，指出分支路由是因果瓶颈。独立通用多模态模型上126次配对试验复现效果（p=4.9×10^-13）。外部基准上与反应式基线整体性能相当，但二者优势互补。

Conclusion: AAPT在候选动作可预先枚举的场景下表现最优，而当候选动作无法预先枚举时，反应式执行仍然更强。这为计算机使用智能体的延迟优化提供了新的设计范式，即在空闲期预计算策略并在事件触发时即时执行。

Abstract: Computer-use agents often fail on transient GUI events because they produce the correct action only after the relevant window has already closed. We identify the main cause as expensive autoregressive decoding on the decision-time critical path. We propose Adaptive Anticipatory Policy Trees (AAPT), which eliminates this delay without modifying the underlying model. During idle screen periods, the same frozen multimodal model constructs a bounded conditional policy tree with observable guards, pre-authorized actions, and branch-specific deadlines. The tree is sized to cover the model's own decoding latency. When an event occurs, a lightweight observer matches change-gated frames to a prepared branch and immediately executes the corresponding action without generating new text. In paired trials with pre-registered endpoints and exact McNemar tests, AAPT improves the success rate from 0.50 to 0.79 within a contested decision window ($p=1.8\times10^{-3}$), while producing no incorrect actions. Both open-loop and predict-and-replan baselines achieve zero success because they still decode during execution. A preparation-time sweep shows that the gain emerges where the latency-based tree-sizing rule predicts, and ablations reveal three key requirements: fast observer decoding, valid tree planning, and accurate branch routing. A pre-registered oracle probe rejects our initial hypothesis and instead points to branch routing as the causal bottleneck. We further reproduce the effect on an independent general-purpose multimodal model over 126 paired trials ($p=4.9\times10^{-13}$). On an external benchmark, AAPT matches the overall performance of a reactive baseline, although the two methods exhibit complementary strengths. Together, these results suggest that AAPT performs best when candidate actions can be enumerated in advance, whereas reactive execution remains stronger when they cannot.

</details>


### [279] [On-Policy and Off-Policy Learning for Large Action Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28408)
*Imad Aouali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了交互式系统中大规模动作空间下的策略学习问题，涵盖上下文赌博机的两大范式：在线学习（最小化遗憾）和离线学习（从日志数据中学习）。提出了基于结构化贝叶斯方法的在线算法（meTS和dTS）以及基于潜在变量、可优化目标函数和悲观正则化的离线方法（sDM、策略加权对数似然和可微悲观方法）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模动作空间的上下文赌博机中，在线学习和离线学习都面临严峻挑战：探索效率低下、数据覆盖稀疏、重要性权重高方差、外推偏差以及优化景观困难等问题。现有方法难以有效应对这些挑战，需要新的结构化方法来解决。

Method: 第一部分提出两种在线学习方法：meTS（混合效应Thompson采样）和dTS（利用扩散启发先验建模动作间依赖关系），通过在动作间共享信息实现高效学习，遗憾保证依赖于有效动作数。第二部分提出sDM（基于潜在变量的结构化直接方法），证明了在大动作空间中优化误差可主导估计误差，并引入凹的、可高效优化的策略加权对数似然目标；最后发展基于指数平滑和PAC-Bayesian界的可微悲观方法，以控制正则化重要性采样估计器的偏差-方差权衡。

Result: 在线学习方法（meTS和dTS）通过跨动作信息共享，获得依赖于有效动作数的遗憾保证；离线学习方法（sDM）揭示优化误差在大动作空间中的主导作用，并通过凹目标和可微悲观方法有效控制偏差-方差权衡。

Conclusion: 本文通过结构化的贝叶斯先验和可优化目标设计，系统解决大规模动作空间中在线与离线策略学习的核心挑战，提供了理论与实践上的改进方案。

Abstract: This thesis studies policy learning in interactive systems where an agent observes a context, selects an action from a very large set, and receives partial feedback. The main framework is contextual bandits, with two paradigms: on-policy learning, where the agent interacts sequentially with the environment and minimizes regret, and off-policy learning, where it learns from logged data collected by a logging policy. In large action spaces, both settings face major challenges: inefficient exploration, sparse data coverage, high-variance importance weights, extrapolation bias, and difficult optimization landscapes. The first part develops structured Bayesian methods for on-policy learning. We introduce meTS, a mixed-effect extension of Thompson sampling, and dTS, which leverages diffusion-inspired priors to model dependencies between actions. These methods share information across actions and yield regret guarantees depending on an effective number of actions. The second part addresses off-policy learning. We propose sDM, a structured direct method based on latent variables, show that optimization error can dominate estimation error in large action spaces, and introduce concave, efficiently optimizable policy-weighted log-likelihood objectives. Finally, we develop differentiable pessimistic methods based on exponential smoothing and PAC-Bayesian bounds to control the bias-variance trade-off of regularized importance-sampling estimators.

</details>


### [280] [QAdapt: A Noise-Adaptive Neural Pre-Decoding Framework for Quantum Error Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28422)
*Ran Miao,Rui Luo,Xiaohan Shan,Xiaoming Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QAdapt是一个噪声自适应的神经预解码框架，用于表面码量子纠错。它捕获综合征数据中的局部时空相关性，顺序适应不断变化的噪声条件同时缓解灾难性遗忘，并将残余综合征转发给传统全局解码器。在110种合成分布外噪声配置和Google Willow基准数据上，QAdapt均显著降低了逻辑错误率和后端解码延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 容错量子计算的性能不仅受物理噪声限制，还受经典解码器处理快速产生的综合征数据的延迟所约束。硬件噪声具有强、异构和非平稳的特性，且模拟到硬件的分布偏移会显著降低固定神经解码器的性能，因此需要自适应噪声的预解码框架。

Method: QAdapt采用神经预解码框架：首先捕获综合征数据中的局部时空相关性，然后通过顺序学习机制适应演变的噪声条件并缓解灾难性遗忘，最后将残余综合征转发给传统的全局解码器进行处理。

Result: 在110种合成分布外噪声配置下，QAdapt一致降低了逻辑错误率。在Google Willow基准数据上，无需目标域微调，逻辑错误率降低最多5.79%，后端解码延迟降低最多9.32%。

Conclusion: QAdapt提供了一种实用且与解码器兼容的方法，能够提升量子纠错在演变硬件噪声下的鲁棒性和后端解码效率。

Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) relies on quantum error correction to suppress physical errors and preserve logical information at scale. In practice, however, performance is constrained not only by physical noise but also by the latency of classical decoders processing rapidly generated syndrome data. This challenge is exacerbated by hardware noise that is strong, heterogeneous, and nonstationary, as well as by the simulation-to-hardware distribution shift that can substantially degrade fixed neural decoders. We present QAdapt, a noise-adaptive neural pre-decoding framework for surface-code quantum error correction. QAdapt captures local spatiotemporal correlations in syndrome data, sequentially adapts to evolving noise conditions while mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and forwards the residual syndrome to a conventional global decoder. Across 110 synthetic out-of-distribution noise configurations for rotated surface-code memory circuits, QAdapt consistently reduces the logical error rate relative to the neural pre-decoding baseline. On Google's Willow benchmark data, without target-domain fine-tuning, it achieves reductions of up to 5.79 percent in logical error rate and 9.32 percent in backend decoding latency on the residual syndrome. These results demonstrate that QAdapt provides a practical and decoder-compatible approach to improving the robustness and backend decoding efficiency of quantum error correction under evolving hardware noise.

</details>


### [281] [Kohn-Sham Spectral Embedding on Sparse Graphs at the Nishimori Temperature for Image Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28428)
*V. S. Usatyuk,D. A. Sapozhnikov,S. I. Egorov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Kohn-Sham谱嵌入（KSSE）模型，用稀疏图谱嵌入替代密集CNN分类器。该方法在Nishimori温度下对随机键Ising模型进行谱分解，利用FFT在O(N log N + k²_mode N)时间内求解D个独立通道谱问题。通过星域手术优化图拓扑，并在ImageNet-1000上以21.24M参数达到88.93% Top-1准确率，超越Swin-L并匹配ViT-H/14。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统密集CNN分类器参数规模庞大且计算效率低下，作者希望利用物理学（量子化学中的Kohn-Sham框架和统计物理中的Ising模型）构建一种稀疏高效的分类模型，在显著降低参数量的同时保持甚至超越SOTA性能。

Method: 1) 将预训练特征映射到准循环LDPC图上，构造正则化拉普拉斯算子作为Kohn-Sham哈密顿量；2) 利用环状块的FFT（借助Z/pZ的Pontryagin自对偶性）和低阶Rayleigh细化求解D个独立通道谱问题；3) 采用星域手术优化图拓扑，通过构造边缘位移在码字周围产生局部凸性，同时将残余挫折界限制在ρ(B_γ)≤1+δ；4) 利用多重分形分析（D₂谱）和分形学习率景观验证从粗糙区到星域盆地的景观转变。

Result: 在ImageNet-1000转导协议下（冻结EfficientNet-B4特征，D=1792），KSSE以约21.24M参数达到88.93% Top-1准确率，超越Swin-L（197M，86.4-87.3%），匹配ViT-H/14（632M，88.0-89.5%），模型体积分别减少10倍和30倍。

Conclusion: KSSE通过物理启发的谱嵌入方法证明了稀疏图模型可以取代传统稠密深度网络分类器，在极小参数规模下实现SOTA级别的分类性能。作者给出六个理论结果（广义Ihara-Bass恒等式、陷阱集特征值对应、加性通道可分离性、手术定理、拟平稳扰动界、定点收敛定理），为该方法的正确性和收敛性提供了严格保证。

Abstract: We introduce Kohn--Sham Spectral Embedding (KSSE), a physics-inspired energy-based model replacing dense CNN classifiers with a sparse-graph spectral embedding evaluated at the Nishimori temperature of an associated Random-Bond Ising Model. By mapping pre-trained features onto quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check graphs and constructing a regularized Laplacian acting as a Kohn--Sham Hamiltonian, we solve $D$ independent channel spectral problems in $\mathcal{O}(N\log N + k^2_{\text{mode}} N)$ time via FFT on circulant blocks (leveraging Pontryagin self-duality of $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$) and low-order Rayleigh refinement. Graph topology is optimized using \emph{star-domain surgery}: rather than destroying information-carrying codewords by removing frustrated cycles, we construct edge shifts creating local convexity around codewords while bounding residual frustration to $ρ(B_γ)\leq 1+δ$. Multi-scale fractal analysis ($D_2$ spectrum) and fractal learning-rate landscape certifies a landscape transition from rough regimes ($D_2>3$) to star-domain basins ($D_2<1$), enabling Rayleigh refinement with $k_{\text{mode}}=5$ modes. We prove six theoretical results: a generalized Ihara--Bass identity linking belief propagation to the Laplacian; trapping-set eigenvalue correspondence; additive channel separability with an explicit exchange-correlation bound; a surgery theorem bounding frustration with attractor width $Ω(1/\sqrt{d_{\min}})$; a quasi-stationarity perturbation bound; and a fixed-point convergence theorem. In a transductive protocol on ImageNet-1000 with frozen EfficientNet-B4 features ($D=1792$), KSSE achieves \textbf{88.93\%} Top-1 accuracy using $\approx 21.24$M parameters, outperforming Swin-L (197M, 86.4--87.3\%) and matching ViT-H/14 (632M, 88.0--89.5\%) under standard inductive setups, while reducing model footprint by $10\times$ and $30\times$, respectively.

</details>


### [282] [Oracle-Budgeted Molecular Optimization with Short-Term Graph Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28437)
*Jiannan Yang,Veronika Thost,Xiang Ling,Tengfei Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"短期图记忆"(short-term graph memory)的即插即用模块，用于分子优化任务。该模块通过在线图神经网络代理对每轮候选分子进行预筛选，在保持生成器架构和原生更新规则不变的前提下，更有效地利用有限的oracle预算。实验表明，该模块在标准分子优化基准上无需额外oracle开销即可提升平均top-10得分，且在1000次调用的紧预算下对所有测试的四种生成器均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子优化通常在有限的oracle预算下进行，因此决定评估什么分子与决定生成什么分子同样重要。现有的方法往往只关注生成器的设计，而忽视了如何更聪明地分配有限的oracle查询预算。

Method: 提出短期图记忆模块作为即插即用组件：(1) 维护一个在线图神经网络代理(surrogate)；(2) 用该代理对每轮生成的候选分子池进行预筛选；(3) 将有限的oracle预算优先分配给预测效用更高的分子；(4) 不改变底层生成器的架构和原生更新规则。

Result: 在标准分子优化基准上，将该模块应用于片段式生成器时，无需额外oracle代价即可提升平均top-10得分，且在所有oracle上均不落后于基线。在一千次调用的紧预算下，四种测试的生成器均获得收益提升。此外，分析表明该模块在大预算下的收益取决于生成器的搜索广度及其原生搜索利用oracle反馈的效率。

Conclusion: 短期图记忆提供了一种简单而有效的方式来更选择性地分配固定的oracle预算，并揭示了哪些类型的生成器最受益于这种代理引导的选择机制。其收益取决于骨干生成器的搜索探索广泛性及对oracle反馈的利用效率。

Abstract: Molecular optimization is commonly performed under a limited oracle budget, which makes deciding what to evaluate as important as deciding what to generate. We introduce short-term graph memory, a plug-in module that preserves the generator architecture and native update rule while learning from previously evaluated molecules to prioritize subsequent oracle queries. The module maintains an online graph neural surrogate that pre-screens each round's candidate pool, so the fixed oracle budget is spent on molecules with higher predicted utility. Applied to a fragment-based generator on a standard molecular optimization benchmark, it improves the mean top-10 score at no extra oracle cost and never falls behind the base on any oracle; the gain extends to all four generators we tested at a tight budget of one thousand calls. We then analyze how surrogate-guided selection interacts with the exploration and exploitation behavior of different generators. Its benefit at larger budgets is consistent with two properties of the backbone: how broadly it searches, and how effectively its native search already exploits oracle feedback. We provide a simple way to spend a fixed oracle budget more selectively, and evidence on which generators benefit from it.

</details>


### [283] [The Role of Causality in Algorithmic Recourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28497)
*Srikanth Avasarala,Varun Gupta,Shahin Jabbari,Saber Salehkaleybar,Juba Ziani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种因果性能（causal performative）框架来处理算法补救（algorithmic recourse）问题，通过结构因果模型建模补救行为对真实标签和特征的影响，解决传统方法仅关注翻转预测而忽视真实资格改善（导致策略性博弈和模型退化）的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的算法补救方法仅关注翻转模型预测结果，未考虑推荐的行为改变是否真正提升个体的真实资格，还是仅仅利用分类器漏洞进行策略性博弈。这导致部署的补救策略会引发行为响应，降低预测精度，并在模型重训后失效。

Method: 作者形式化了因果性能框架：通过结构因果模型（SCM）建模补救行为在特征间的传播及其对真实标签的影响；分析因果响应导致的非凸优化问题；刻画性能稳定解存在及可通过简单迭代动力学高效计算的条件；将因果感知的补救策略与忽略因果结构的经验风险最小化（ERM）进行对比。

Result: 在半合成数据和真实信用数据集上的实验表明，所提方法 consistently 优于标准经验风险最小化，同时减少了因策略性行为导致的分布偏移而需要的重复模型重训次数；因果补救达到稳定均衡，降低了博弈激励。

Conclusion: 忽略因果结构的补救策略会引发大规模、错位的行为响应，而因果感知的补救策略能收敛到稳定均衡，减少策略性博弈的动机，提升模型的长期有效性和预测准确性。

Abstract: Algorithmic recourse aims to provide individuals with actionable changes to improve their predicted outcomes in high-stakes classification settings, such as loan and mortgage applications. However, most existing approaches focus only on flipping a model's prediction, without accounting for whether the recommended changes lead to genuine improvement in an individual's true qualifications or merely enable strategic gaming of the classifier. Consequently, deployed recourse policies can induce behavioral responses that degrade predictive accuracy and become ineffective after model retraining.
  In this work, we formalize this failure mode through a causal performative framework for recourse. We model how recourse actions propagate through a structural causal model, capturing interactions among features as well as their effect on the true label. These causal responses induce a non-convex optimization problem, even under standard convex losses. We characterize conditions under which performatively stable solutions exist and can be efficiently computed via simple iterative dynamics. Our analysis reveals that recourse policies that ignore causal structure can induce large, misaligned behavioral responses, whereas causal recourse leads to stable equilibria that reduce incentives for gaming. Experiments on both semi-synthetic and real credit datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms standard empirical risk minimization while reducing the need for repeated model retraining to accommodate distribution shifts caused by strategic agent behavior.

</details>


### [284] [Same Graph Cross-Task Transfer in GNNs: Protocols and Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28525)
*Neelam Akula,Surbhi Kumar,Murat Kantarcioglu,Baris Coskunuzer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次形式化定义了同图上的节点分类(NC)与链路预测(LP)跨任务迁移问题，并提出一个无泄漏的评估协议，通过三个骨干网络(GCN、GraphSAGE、GPS)的广泛实验，揭示了迁移的方向性和可预测性规律，并引入CoTask Score(CTS)指标来量化共享编码器下联合任务的效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估协议在数据划分、观测图假设和负采样规则上存在不一致性，导致关于同图跨任务迁移的结论不可靠。作者希望通过统一、无泄漏的协议来重新审视NC和LP之间的知识迁移关系，避免由于评估设置差异带来的误导性结论。

Method: 1) 形式化定义同图NC-LP迁移问题；2) 提出无泄漏评估协议：固定节点和边的划分、使用排除评估边的共享消息传递图、LP采用固定负样本；3) 在GCN、GraphSAGE、GPS三个骨干网络上进行系统实验；4) 提出CoTask Score(CTS)用以衡量共享编码器同时服务NC和LP的联合效用；5) 利用数据集统计量（尤其是同质性）指导迁移机制的选择。

Result: 发现迁移具有强方向性：NC→LP在同质图(homophilic graphs)上始终有益；而LP→NC则较脆弱，在朴素表示复用下甚至可能降低准确率。LP→NC仅在"结构主导"（结构易学而NC未饱和）的机制下可靠地产生正面收益，表明LP起着结构预训练的作用。CTS能够总结共享编码器下的联合任务效用，同质性等简单统计量可有效指导机制选择以避免负迁移。

Conclusion: 同图NC-LP跨任务迁移是方向性且可预测的；同质性是选择迁移机制的重要信号；研究者应使用无泄漏的评估协议来获得可靠的迁移结论，并通过CTS等指标量化共享编码器的联合任务性能。

Abstract: Many real-world graphs support multiple predictive tasks over the same underlying structure, creating an opportunity to reuse supervision across node classification (NC) and link prediction (LP). However, existing evaluations often rely on incompatible splits, observed-graph assumptions, and negative sampling rules, making conclusions about same-graph cross-task transfer unreliable. We formalize same-graph NC-LP transfer and propose a leakage-free protocol that fixes node and edge splits, uses a shared message-passing graph that excludes evaluated edges, and employs fixed negatives for LP. Across three backbones (GCN, GraphSAGE, GPS), we find that transfer is strongly directional and predictable: NC $\to$ LP is consistently beneficial on homophilic graphs, while LP $\to$ NC is fragile and can even degrade accuracy under naive representation reuse. LP $\to$ NC becomes reliably positive mainly in a structure-dominant regime where LP is easy but NC is unsaturated, suggesting that LP acts as structural pretraining. Finally, we introduce the CoTask Score (CTS) to summarize joint NC+LP utility when a shared encoder must serve both tasks, and show that simple dataset statistics, especially homophily, can guide mechanism choice and help avoid negative transfer.

</details>


### [285] [APO: Unsupervised Atomic Policy Optimization for 3D Structure Prediction of Atomic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28553)
*Shentong Mo,Yatao Bian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出APO（原子策略优化），一种完全无监督的3D原子结构生成对齐框架，通过群相对策略优化和双奖励机制（潜在结构模式强化+热力学稳定性约束），无需实验标注坐标即可实现晶体和抗体结构预测，在匹配率和结构保真度上超越全监督基线，并提升了推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流匹配模型（如FlowDPO）在3D原子结构预测上依赖与真实坐标的监督偏好学习，但获取新型晶体相或从头设计蛋白的实验标签成本极高，严重制约了数据稀缺场景下的结构建模能力。需要一种无需参考结构的无监督对齐方法。

Method: APO将群相对策略优化（GRPO）适配到3D原子环境，提出双奖励机制：(i) 通过对样本相似性的特征分解（eigen-decomposition）强化策略的支配性潜在结构模式；(ii) 热力学稳定性奖励以约束物理合理性。通过识别采样群内物理可实现的构象实现模型的"自纠正"。

Result: 在晶体和抗体结构预测的广泛基准测试中，APO一致地优于全监督基线，在匹配率和结构保真度上达到新的最先进水平；同时有效拉直概率路径，显著提升推理效率。

Conclusion: APO证明了内在物理一致性可以比含噪的监督坐标匹配更好地指导对齐，为数据稀缺场景下的3D原子结构建模提供了新范式。

Abstract: Predicting the 3D structures of atomic systems is fundamental to advancing material science and drug discovery. While flow-matching models (, FlowDPO) have recently shown promise in this domain, their performance relies heavily on alignment with ground-truth coordinates via supervised preference learning. However, obtaining experimental labels for novel crystal phases or de novo proteins is prohibitively expensive, creating a bottleneck for structural modeling in data-scarce regimes. In this work, we propose (Atomic Policy Optimization), a fully unsupervised alignment framework that eliminates the need for ground-truth reference structures. APO adapts group-relative policy optimization to 3D atomic environments, utilizing a novel dual-reward mechanism: (i) a that reinforces the policy's dominant latent structural modes through eigen-decomposition of sample similarities, and (ii) a that enforces thermodynamic stability. Our framework enables the model to ``self-correct'' by identifying physically plausible configurations within sampled groups. Extensive benchmarks on crystal and antibody structure prediction demonstrate that APO consistently outperforms fully supervised baselines, achieving a new state-of-the-art in match rates and structural fidelity. Furthermore, we show that APO effectively straightens probability paths, significantly improving inference efficiency. Our results suggest that intrinsic physical consistency can serve as a superior guide for alignment compared to noisy, supervised coordinate matching.

</details>


### [286] [$β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28582)
*Jiawei Xu,Minghui Liu,Juzheng Zhang,Tom Goldstein,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出β-OPSD方法，通过将普通在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）推广为可调节KL惩罚强度的策略优化家族，并以蒸馏方式近似昂贵的RL目标，在数学推理任务上显著优于vanilla OPSD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: vanilla OPSD虽然能提升推理语言模型，但在实际应用中不稳定、需要大量工程调参。作者识别出其根本原因：vanilla OPSD是β=1的特殊情况，KL惩罚权重固定为1，缺乏可调节性，导致无法灵活权衡参考策略与教师指导之间的关系。

Method: 1) 将OPSD重新表述为更一般的策略优化家族β-OPSD，其中β控制KL惩罚权重；2) 推导其最优策略的闭式解——参考策略与特权教师之间的几何插值；3) 不直接优化高成本的RL目标，而是利用闭式解构造蒸馏目标，通过混合token级logits高效实现；4) 引入Return-to-go（RTG）信用分配，使token更新与序列级目标对齐。

Result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，β-OPSD一致优于vanilla OPSD，提升了优化稳定性和下游推理性能。

Conclusion: 该工作为从自蒸馏到策略优化提供了一条原理性路径，在不牺牲OPSD实用效率的前提下，使β成为可调节的正则化超参数，弥合了廉价蒸馏与昂贵策略优化之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising approach to improve reasoning language models, but it remains brittle in practice: making it work reliably often requires substantial engineering effort. We identify a structural source of this difficulty: vanilla OPSD is precisely the $β=1$ member of a broader policy-optimization family, where $β$ weights the KL penalty anchoring the student to a reference policy. This equivalence turns $β$ from an implicit value fixed at one into a controllable regularization parameter, yielding a more general formulation that trades off proximity to a reference policy against privileged teacher guidance. We introduce $β$-OPSD and derive its optimal policy as a geometric interpolation between the reference policy and the privileged teacher. Directly optimizing this objective with reinforcement learning, however, would be costly and high-variance. Rather than optimize the RL objective directly, we turn its closed-form solution into a distillation target. Each value of $β$ selects a target along the reference-to-teacher path, which we implement efficiently by mixing their token-level logits. In this way, inexpensive distillation approximates the solution of expensive policy optimization. Return-to-go credit assignment further aligns token updates with the sequence-level objective while retaining the simplicity of OPSD. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that $β$-OPSD consistently outperforms vanilla OPSD, improving optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance. Our results provide a principled route from self-distillation to policy optimization and back without sacrificing the efficiency that makes OPSD practical.

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

# cs.CR [[Back]](#toc)

### [287] [FAVA: Formal Authorization for Verified Agents with Evidence-Backed Permission Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27267)
*Yifan Zhang,Xinkui Zhao,Sai Liu,Hengxuan Lou,Guanjie Cheng,Chang Liu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: FAVA是一个面向LLM智能体的形式化授权框架，通过权限中间表示(IR)将自然语言任务翻译为结构化约束，再通过确定性降级转换为带证据的权限图，并使用SMT求解器对安全策略进行数学验证，最终通过运行时网关强制执行授权决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在动态环境中自主执行任务时，静态的工具级权限无法满足安全需求，因为安全授权高度依赖上下文和运行时状态，需要一种能够感知数据流和依赖关系的动态授权机制。

Method: FAVA方法包含四个核心组件：(1) LLM引导的权限中间表示(IR)，将模糊的自然语言任务转换为结构化约束；(2) 确定性降级步骤，将IR转换为跟踪数据流、依赖关系和上下文标签的带证据权限图；(3) SMT授权器，在执行任何有效操作前对当前图进行数学验证；(4) 运行时网关，执行求解器结果，授权或拦截并提供精确反例。

Result: 在OpenAgentSafety、OctoBench和ActPlane场景上的评估显示，FAVA在聚合数据集上达到了90.5%的决策合规率(DCR)，并在trace-conditioned场景中成功拦截动态违规轨迹。

Conclusion: FAVA通过形式化验证方法为LLM智能体提供了严格且可证明的安全授权保障，弥补了静态权限机制的不足，为智能体在复杂动态环境中的安全执行提供了一种可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents autonomously interleave semantic reasoning with complex system operations. In these dynamic environments, static tool-level permissions are fundamentally insufficient; safe authorization is highly context-dependent and heavily reliant on evolving runtime states and data flows. We present FAVA (Formal Authorization for Verified Agents), a permission-carrying authorization framework for agent execution. FAVA utilizes an LLM-guided Permission Intermediate Representation (IR) to translate ambiguous natural-language tasks into structured constraints. A deterministic lowering pass then converts this IR into an evidence-backed permission graph that explicitly tracks data flows, dependencies, and contextual labels. To provide strict security guarantees, a Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) authorizer mathematically verifies the current graph against security policies before any effectful action executes. A runtime gateway then enforces the solver's result, either authorizing the execution or intercepting it with a precise counterexample. We evaluate FAVA across OpenAgentSafety, OctoBench, and ActPlane scenarios. Our evaluation demonstrates that FAVA achieves a 90.5% Decision Compliance Rate (DCR) over the aggregate dataset, successfully intercepting dynamic violating traces in the evaluated trace-conditioned scenarios.

</details>


### [288] [Open Security Benchmark: Towards Autonomous Enterprise Cyber Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27288)
*Gal Engelberg,Michael Arenzon,Leon Goldberg*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出OSB（开放安全基准）框架，用于评估自主网络防御中的智能体AI。该框架通过冻结企业安全环境快照，支持text-to-SQL和原生API两种模态的安全态势调查评估，解决"环境数据缺口"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着企业转向自主网络防御（智能体AI构建态势感知并推理决策），评估重点从"能否产生答案"转向"是否值得信任"。但真实企业环境是私有的、跨厂商的、深度关联的，没有公开可查询的共享环境来端到端评估此类智能体，存在"环境数据缺口"。

Method: OSB框架由五个组件构成：数据层、任务与评估集层、多维评分层、最小可审计测试平台、以及自带路径（统一基底同时支持公开比较和私有租户评估）。框架冻结企业安全环境为不可变快照，锚定封闭式地面真值，并通过两种模态评估态势调查：关系快照上的text-to-SQL及同一环境实例的厂商原生API。

Result: 框架以两个身份安全包和一系列多规模合成组织环境数据集实例化，并规划了向更多态势子域、调查模态及从评估到修复的防御阶段扩展的路径。

Conclusion: OSB提供了首个可共享、可查询的端到端智能体AI安全评估基底，通过冻结环境快照和封闭式地面真值，弥合了真实企业环境不可公开访问与智能体可信评估需求之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: Enterprises are moving toward autonomous cyber defense: agentic AI that builds situational awareness of an organization's security state and reasons from it to assessments, decisions, and actions. This rests on a holistic view of the enterprise's security state, the continuous, cross-vendor picture of identities, cloud and infrastructure, data, applications, and their configurations that security posture management assembles. As agents take on this work, what matters is not whether an agent can produce an answer but whether it should be trusted to. The field cannot yet answer this question. Real enterprise environments are private, cross-vendor, and deeply correlated, and none is exposed publicly as a shared, queryable target for evaluating such agents end to end. We call this the environment data gap. We present Open Security Benchmark (OSB), a framework that benchmarks agentic AI on this work. OSB surfaces a curated enterprise environment - a frozen, holistic view of the security state - and evaluates posture investigation across two modalities: text-to-SQL over a relational snapshot and each vendor's native API over a served instance of the same environment. Freezing the environment pins the target state as an immutable snapshot and anchors answers to a closed-form ground truth. OSB is built from five components: a data layer, a task and evaluation-set layer, a multi-dimensional scoring layer, a minimal auditable harness, and a bring-your-own path that serves public comparison and private tenant evaluation from one substrate. We instantiate the framework with two identity-security packs and a family of synthetic-organization environment datasets spanning multiple scales, and chart its extension to further posture subdomains, investigation modalities, and defense stages from assessment toward remediation.

</details>


### [289] [RoguePrompt: Dual-Layer Encoding for Self-Reconstruction to Circumvent LLM Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27373)
*Benyamin Tafreshian,Prathamesh Dhake*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了RoguePrompt，一种利用双层嵌套编码（Vigenere+ROT13）和提示词分区的越狱攻击流水线，在黑盒威胁模型下于313个真实硬拒绝提示上进行测试，实现了93.93%的过滤绕过率、79.02%的重构率和70.18%的执行率，并在阶段级别揭示了多阶段攻击的失败点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM已配备安全控制机制，基于提示词的策略规避（越狱攻击）仍是重大挑战。已有工作证明了密码介导交互、代码嵌入解密、提示分解重构和分层自定义加密等攻击原语的有效性，但现有评估通常将可见接受、秘密请求恢复和后续执行合并为一个聚合攻击成功率，缺乏对多阶段提示转换攻击在可观测黑盒交互中具体失败环节的细粒度证据。

Method: RoguePrompt流水线包含三个关键步骤：(1) 将受限提示进行分区拆分；(2) 应用两层嵌套编码——Vigenere加密后接ROT13加密；(3) 附加自然语言重构指令。采用黑盒威胁模型，仅通过API或用户界面访问托管模型，在313个真实世界且被硬拒绝的提示上进行测试。成功度量按阶段分开评估：审核绕过（moderation bypass）、指令重构（instruction reconstruction）和执行（execution），每个阶段均设置自动化判定标准。

Result: RoguePrompt在313个硬拒绝提示上实现了93.93%的过滤器绕过率、79.02%的指令重构率和70.18%的执行率，三个阶段的成功率呈现递减趋势，说明攻击失败主要发生在后续阶段而非初始的审核绕过阶段。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明分层提示编码（双层嵌套加密+分区重构）在绕过LLM安全机制方面具有显著有效性，同时提供了阶段级证据，明确了多阶段越狱攻击在审核绕过、指令重构和执行三个环节的具体失败分布，为理解和防御此类攻击提供了更精细的视角。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly integrated into mainstream development platforms and daily technological workflows, typically behind moderation and safety controls. Despite these controls, preventing prompt-based policy evasion remains challenging, and adversaries continue to "jailbreak" LLMs by crafting prompts that circumvent implemented safety mechanisms. Prior work has established cipher-mediated interaction, code-embedded decryption, prompt decomposition and reconstruction, and layered custom encryption as viable attack primitives. However, reported evaluations generally collapse visible acceptance, successful recovery of the concealed request, and subsequent execution into an aggregate attack-success outcome. This leaves limited evidence about where multistage prompt-transformation attacks fail within an observable black-box interaction. This paper introduces RoguePrompt, a jailbreak pipeline that partitions a forbidden prompt and applies two nested encodings, Vigenere followed by ROT13, along with natural-language reconstruction instructions. RoguePrompt was developed and evaluated under a black-box threat model, with only API or user-interface access to the hosted models, and was tested on 313 real-world, hard-rejected prompts. Success was measured in terms of moderation bypass, instruction reconstruction, and execution when the relevant stage exceeded its automated criterion. RoguePrompt achieved average rates of 93.93% for filter bypass, 79.02% for reconstruction, and 70.18% for execution. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of layered prompt encoding while providing stage-level evidence of where multistage jailbreaks fail during moderation bypass, instruction reconstruction, and execution.

</details>


### [290] [Low-Latency Bootstrapping for CKKS using Roots of Unity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27401)
*Jean-Sebastien Coron,Robin Koestler*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出SPRU（Sparse Roots of Unity）自举算法，用于CKKS同态加密方案。与传统的通过多项式逼近模约减的方法不同，SPRU将模q的加法群直接嵌入复数单位根中，利用CKKS方案原生计算该运算。该方法显著降低了自举所需的乘法深度，从而允许使用更小的环维数并提升效率。在OpenFHE C++库中实现时，对于小槽位数的密文，延迟最多可降低5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CKKS自举是近似算术同态加密中代价最高的操作，传统方法通过同态评估近似模约减的多项式来实现，这导致乘法深度较高，进而需要较大的环维数来支持自举，整体计算效率受限。作者旨在寻找一种新的自举范式来降低乘法深度，从而提升自举效率。

Method: SPRU自举的核心思想是将模q的加法群直接嵌入复数单位根（roots of unity），利用CKKS方案天然支持复数运算的特性来原生计算该嵌入操作，从而避免了对模约减多项式的高深度逼近。由于大幅降低了乘法深度要求，可以采用更小的环维数进行自举。

Result: 在OpenFHE C++库中实现SPRU自举算法，针对小槽位数的密文场景，延迟相比原始CKKS自举方法最多可降低5倍。

Conclusion: SPRU自举通过利用单位根嵌入的新思路，从根本上改变了CKKS自举的实现方式，以更低的乘法深度实现了自举功能，在特定场景下（小槽位）显著提升了效率，为CKKS自举提供了一种新的高效替代方案。

Abstract: We introduce Sparse Roots of Unity (SPRU) bootstrapping, a new bootstrapping algorithm for the CKKS homomorphic encryption scheme for approximate arithmetic. The original CKKS bootstrapping method relies on homomorphically evaluating a polynomial that approximates modular reduction modulo q. In contrast, SPRU bootstrapping directly embeds the additive group modulo q into the complex roots of unity, which can be evaluated natively in the CKKS scheme. This approach significantly reduces the multiplicative depth required for bootstrapping, enabling the use of a smaller ring dimension and improving efficiency. In practice, using the OpenFHE C++ library, SPRU bootstrapping achieves up to a 5x reduction in latency when applied to ciphertexts with a small number of slots.

</details>


### [291] [Granite: A Modular Methodology for Foundational Verification of Hardware-Software Leakage Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27480)
*Stella Lau,Andres Erbsen,Adam Chlipala*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Granite是一种用于RTL处理器模块化验证的方法，同时证明功能正确性和信息非泄漏性，通过泄漏感知精化与确定性建立轨迹等价，从ISA契约级别到微架构级周期级执行实现可组合的机密性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理器设计需要在功能正确性之外验证安全属性，特别是时序侧信道的信息泄漏问题。传统方法难以同时处理功能正确性与机密性，且缺乏从指令集级契约到微架构级执行的模块化、可组合验证框架。

Method: Granite采用泄漏感知精化（leakage-aware refinement）与确定性技术，将正确性和机密性统一为相对于确定性规范机的轨迹等价。通过存在量化未可信的、仅作用于公共数据的确定性函数来处理秘密独立非确定性。子模块依据自身泄漏感知规范进行证明，证明可组合为整体设计保证。最终与认证的静态分析组合，消除中间规范依赖。

Result: 方法证明了流水线RISC设计（含推测执行、精确中断和I/O）的周期级时序仅由ISA泄漏契约中指定的可观察量决定。对遵循密码学常数时间纪律的程序，排除了已知和未知时序侧信道的信息泄漏。证明可组合构成单个Rocq定理，覆盖硬件-软件密码实现的周期级机密性。

Conclusion: Granite是首个实现指令集级泄漏契约与微架构级周期级执行之间模块化、基础性连接的工作。通过消除ISA契约等中间规范的可信计算基，建立了从软件常数时间到硬件时序机密性的完备、可组合验证链。

Abstract: Granite is a methodology for modular verification of both functional correctness and nonleakage of RTL processors against ISA contracts. We prove that the cycle-by-cycle timing of a pipelined RISC design--with speculation, precise interrupts, and I/O--is determined solely by observables specified in an ISA leakage contract. For programs that keep observables independent of secrets (i.e., following the cryptographic-constant-time discipline), this result rules out information leakage through known and unknown timing side channels.
  Granite's specifications only constrain functional correctness and information-flow dependencies: not how many cycles an instruction takes, at which instruction an interrupt is handled, or the exact latencies of submodules such as multipliers and memory. Granite's central technique is leakage-aware refinement via determinism, which establishes correctness and confidentiality together as trace equivalence with respect to a family of cycle-level, deterministic spec machines. Secret-independent nondeterminism is handled by existentially parameterizing specs with untrusted, deterministic functions acting only on public data. Submodules are proved against their own leakage-aware specs, and these proofs compose into the whole-design guarantee--which therefore holds over a space of secure implementations.
  We believe this work is the first to achieve modular and foundational connection between instruction-set-level leakage contracts and microarchitecture-specific cycle-by-cycle execution with wire-level observations. Our proofs compose with a certified static analysis that recognizes cryptographic-constant-time code to derive a single Rocq theorem about the cycle-by-cycle confidentiality of a hardware-and-software cryptographic implementation--eliminating every intermediate specification, including the ISA contract itself, from the trusted computing base.

</details>


### [292] [Flock: Fast Proving for Batch Boolean Computations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27491)
*Benedikt Bünz,Ron D. Rothblum,William Wang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: Flock是一个基于哈希的SNARK系统，针对大规模布尔电路批量证明进行极致优化，可在M4 Max单核上每秒证明82k次BLAKE3压缩函数、42k次SHA-256压缩和30k次Keccak置换，性能比现有一流方案快9倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在许多SNARK应用中，证明大规模标准加密哈希函数（如SHA-256、Keccak、BLAKE3）的求值成为关键瓶颈，需要一种能够极快证明这类批量布尔计算的高效方案。

Method: Flock将lincheck和zerocheck协议进行新优化，并采用由编码智能体协同设计的激进优化原型实现，证明相同R1CS电路批次及其输入输出关系，支持哈希链和Merkle路径开证明，可扩展至哈希签名验证。

Result: 单核M4 Max处理器上每秒证明82k次BLAKE3压缩、42k次SHA-256压缩和30k次Keccak置换，开销仅为原生执行的250倍以下；十核吞吐超660k次BLAKE3压缩/秒；SHA-256证明比Binius64快9倍以上，比最快的椭圆曲线SNARK快500倍以上。

Conclusion: Flock在大批量哈希函数证明任务上取得了数量级的性能提升，展示了布尔电路SNARK在实际应用中的巨大潜力。

Abstract: For many applications of SNARKs, a key bottleneck is proving large batches of standard cryptographic hash evaluations, such as SHA-256, Keccak, or BLAKE3. We introduce Flock, a hash-based SNARK for extremely fast proving of such batched Boolean computations. Flock proves batches of the same R1CS circuit (plus input/output relations between them), can prove hash-chains and Merkle path openings, and in principle can be extended to full-fledged hash-based signature verification. At its core, Flock combines new optimizations for the lincheck and zerocheck protocols with an aggressively optimized proof-of-concept implementation co-designed by coding agents.
  On a single core of an M4 Max processor, Flock proves 82k evaluations of the BLAKE3 compression function, 42k SHA-256 compressions, and 30k Keccak permutations per second --- less than a $250\times$ overhead over native execution. On ten cores, throughput exceeds 660k BLAKE3 compressions per second; in proving SHA-256, Flock is more than $9\times$ faster than Binius64, the prior state of the art, and more than $500\times$ faster than the fastest elliptic curve-based SNARK we measured against.

</details>


### [293] [Send and Pretend: Exploiting Transcript Consistency Issues in End-to-End Encrypted Group Chats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27510)
*Gabriel K. Gegenhuber,Moritz Grefner,Maximilian Günther,Matthäus Wininger,David Schmidt,Aljosha Judmayer*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文揭示主流端到端加密（E2EE）即时通讯应用（如Signal、iMessage、Threema和WhatsApp）在群聊中无法保证"会话转录一致性"（TC），恶意群成员可利用协议回退路径、成对投递通道等多种双重话语（equivocation）向量，向不同接收者选择性省略、重排或篡改内容而不会触发用户界面警告。研究展示了具体攻击场景（社交工程、规避审核、操纵投票等），并提出了低开销的缓解措施和UI信令策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: E2EE消息应用在群聊中被广泛用于敏感协调（如政治决策），且Signal和iMessage等已引入投票功能，暗示所有参与者应看到相同结果。然而，当前尚无系统性研究验证主流E2EE协议在恶意参与者威胁模型下是否真正保证转录一致性（TC）。作者旨在填补这一空白，揭示实际安全隐患。

Method: 采用恶意参与者威胁模型，系统性分析主流E2EE信使（Signal、iMessage、Threema、WhatsApp）的群聊协议，从两个方面展开：1）共享转录完整性攻击；2）跨用户关联设备的不一致投递。识别多种双重话语向量（从协议回退路径到群组内的成对私密投递通道），并实证构建具体的利用场景，同时梳理实现层面的隐私泄露行为（如设备OS指纹识别）。

Result: 发现所有主流E2EE即时通讯应用在群聊中均无法保证任何形式的转录一致性；恶意群成员可无警告地选择性省略、重排或篡改内容。识别出多项具体的利用场景，包括社会工程攻击、规避审核、操纵群投票等，并发现了与隐私相关的实现特定行为（如设备OS指纹识别）。

Conclusion: 主流E2EE群聊协议存在系统性的转录一致性缺失问题，需要协议层面的设计改进。作者给出了可集成到现有协议中的低开销缓解措施和UI信令策略，并将发现置于先前转录一致性研究的框架中进行了上下文阐述，为该领域的进一步改进提供了方向。

Abstract: End-to-end encrypted (E2EE) messaging apps are widely praised for their security and thus also used for sensitive coordination in group chats (e.g., by political decision makers). After Threema and WhatsApp, also Signal and iMessage have recently introduced polls to aid agreement processes in groups. This implicitly sets the expectation that all participants see the same outcome and thus have the same view of the conversation. This property is commonly referred to as transcript consistency (TC). In this work, we demonstrate that today's major E2EE messengers do not guarantee any form of TC for group chats, allowing a malicious group member to selectively omit, reorder, or present altered content to different recipients without triggering warnings in their user interface. We systematically investigate the extent of the problem under a malicious-participant threat model that targets the integrity of the shared transcript, or inconsistent delivery across a user's linked devices. We identify multiple equivocation vectors that range from protocol fallback paths to deliberate use of pairwise delivery channels within groups. We demonstrate concrete exploitation scenarios such as social engineering, evading moderation, and, in particular, rigging polls. Beyond these cross-service design issues, we also uncover implementation-specific behaviors with privacy implications (e.g., device OS fingerprinting). Finally, we contextualize our findings within prior transcript-consistency research and outline practical low-overhead mitigations and UI signaling strategies that can be integrated into state-of-the-art E2EE group protocols.

</details>


### [294] [ThreatForest: Multi-Agent Attack Tree Generation with Pluggable TTP Framework Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27528)
*Cristian Leo,Anton Dykyi,Danny Cortegaca,Daniel Begimher,Prakash Jha*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: ThreatForest是一个多智能体系统，能从源代码仓库自动生成结构化的攻击树，将攻击步骤映射到MITRE ATT&CK、CAPEC等框架的TTPs，并合成可操作的缓解措施。系统通过多阶段流水线编排（含确定性验证门、有界重试和三个人机协同验证点）实现。评估表明嵌入阶段（而非流水线本身）是主要精度瓶颈，TTP映射得分仅0.29，而威胁陈述、攻击树和缓解措施质量达0.63-0.68。这是首个端到端将代码仓库转化为跨框架TTP映射攻击树并附带证据缓解措施的系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 威胁建模是安全软件开发的关键环节，但云原生架构的手动威胁分析速度慢且需要稀缺的安全专家资源。现有方法缺乏自动化、系统化的端到端解决方案，能够将源代码直接转化为结构化、可操作的威胁模型。

Method: ThreatForest采用多智能体流水线架构，包含五个阶段：仓库分析、上下文精炼、威胁生成、并行攻击树构建（含TTP映射与缓解措施合成）、报告生成。整个流程以有向图编排，具备确定性验证门和有界重试机制，并设置三个人机协同验证点。TTP映射通过特定领域的sentence-transformer计算余弦相似度实现。评估采用七域16维度评分标准，由独立LLM评分员配合对抗性验证和专业审查完成，并设置单次调用基线进行对照实验。

Result: 在七个应用领域的评估中，威胁陈述、攻击树和缓解措施的质量得分达到0.63-0.68（0-1量表），而嵌入-only的TTP映射得分仅为0.29，且在所有领域保持一致。对照实验表明，同一模型上的单次调用基线将映射可辩护性提升了一倍以上，说明瓶颈在于嵌入编码器而非多智能体架构本身。

Conclusion: ThreatForest是首个端到端将代码仓库转化为跨对抗框架TTP映射的攻击树并附带基于证据的缓解措施的系统。实证揭示了嵌入阶段是TTP映射精度的关键瓶颈，为未来改进指明了方向，同时提供了可复用的基准测试框架。

Abstract: Threat modeling is essential for secure software development, yet manual analysis of cloud-native architectures is slow and demands scarce security expertise. We present ThreatForest, a multi-agent system that generates structured attack trees from source code repositories, maps attack steps to adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) from a pluggable set of frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, CAPEC, and cloud-specific threat matrices), and synthesizes actionable mitigations. ThreatForest decomposes threat modeling into a multi-stage agent pipeline -- repository analysis, context refinement, threat generation, parallel attack-tree construction with TTP mapping and mitigation synthesis, and report generation -- orchestrated as a directed graph with deterministic verification gates, bounded retries, and three human-in-the-loop validation points. A domain-specific sentence-transformer maps each attack step to candidate techniques by cosine similarity; we show empirically that this embedding stage, not the surrounding pipeline, is the dominant accuracy bottleneck. We evaluate ThreatForest across seven application domains on a sixteen-dimension rubric, scored by a panel of independent LLM raters with an adversarial verification pass and expert review. Panel-measured quality reaches 0.63-0.68 (on a 0-1 scale) for threat statements, attack trees, and mitigations, but only 0.29 for embedding-only TTP mapping -- a gap stable across all seven domains that isolates the binding constraint. A controlled single-call baseline on the same model more than doubles mapping defensibility, pinning the limitation on the embedding encoder rather than the multi-agent design. To our knowledge, ThreatForest is the first end-to-end system that turns a code repository into TTP-mapped attack trees with evidence-based mitigations across adversary frameworks, with a reusable framework for benchmarking such systems.

</details>


### [295] [Secure Aggregation for Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning on Clinical EEG Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28191)
*Pouya Rajabi,Mohsen Toorani*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向临床脑电图（EEG）数据的隐私保护联邦学习框架，采用基于掩码的安全聚合作为核心保护机制，结合图通信、阈值秘密共享、抗丢失聚合等技术，支持半诚实和恶意两种聚合场景，并在TUH EEG模拟跨机构医疗环境中验证了其安全性与开销权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习允许多机构在不交换原始临床EEG数据的条件下共同训练模型，但无法完全防止个体模型更新造成隐私泄露，因此需要额外的隐私保护机制。

Method: 采用掩码式安全聚合作为核心保护机制，整合图基通信、阈值秘密共享、抗丢失聚合（dropout-resilient aggregation）、局部更新裁剪、可选的基于Bloom filter的隐私保护记录链接初始化模块，以及辅助公证人（auxiliary notary）实现可验证性。框架同时支持半诚实与恶意两种聚合设置，并基于Flower联邦学习框架实现。

Result: 在TUH EEG模拟跨机构医疗场景下评估了不同客户端配置下的安全聚合变体。在所设定假设下，安全变体能够对聚合服务器隐藏个体更新；与联邦模型训练兼容，但恶意设置下的防护与一致性检查机制会引入额外的计算、通信和轮次时长开销。半诚实变体开销最低，恶意与辅助公证人变体提供更强的一致性、完整性和轻量级验证支持但成本更高。

Conclusion: 掩码式安全聚合的联邦学习框架能够在临床EEG数据场景下有效保护个体更新隐私，且各安全变体在隐私保护强度与开销之间存在明确的权衡，为实际医疗场景中的隐私保护联邦学习部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Federated learning enables multiple institutions to train shared models without exchanging raw clinical EEG data, but it does not fully prevent privacy leakage from individual model updates. This paper presents a privacy-preserving federated learning framework for clinical EEG data using masking-based secure aggregation as the core protection mechanism. The framework combines graph-based communication, threshold secret sharing, dropout-resilient aggregation, local update clipping, an optional Bloom filter-based privacy-preserving record-linkage initialization module, and auxiliary-notary-based verifiability. It supports both semi-honest and malicious aggregation settings and is implemented using the Flower federated learning framework. The secure-aggregation variants are evaluated in a simulated cross-silo healthcare setting using TUH EEG-derived data under different client configurations. Under the stated assumptions, the secure variants hide individual updates from the aggregation server. The results show that these variants remain compatible with federated model training, although malicious-setting safeguards and lightweight consistency-checking mechanisms introduce additional computation, communication, and round-duration overhead. The semi-honest variant provides the lowest overhead among the secure configurations, while malicious and auxiliary-notary variants offer stronger consistency, integrity, and lightweight verification support at higher cost.

</details>


### [296] [AnchorMark: Robust Diffusion Watermarking via Latent-Space Rotation Synchrony](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27551)
*Yuqi Qian,Yun Cao,Haocheng Fu,Haochen Zhao,Hong Zhang,Meineng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出AnchorMark，一种无训练的鲁棒反向水印方法。它利用发现的"旋转同步性"潜在空间性质——图像域旋转与恢复的初始潜变量旋转角度相同——通过在初始潜变量中心区域嵌入同步锚点，在水印提取时准确估计并校正旋转角度，从而有效抵抗包含旋转在内的复合有损后处理攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于反向的水印方法在嵌入时不经过独立的图像域后嵌入阶段，保持了合成图像的原生视觉保真度。然而，现有方法在面对复合有损后处理（尤其是旋转攻击）时依然脆弱，因为旋转破坏了潜空间解码所需的像素空间对应关系。

Method: 提出AnchorMark，一个训练自由的鲁棒反向水印框架。核心发现是"旋转同步性"（Rotation Synchrony）：图像域的旋转与恢复到的初始潜变量中的对应旋转具有相同角度。基于此性质，AnchorMark在初始潜变量的中心区域嵌入同步锚点，提取时利用锚点精确估计旋转角度并予以校正，从而恢复潜空间的空间对齐关系。

Result: 实验表明，AnchorMark在旋转攻击和复合攻击下显著提升了比特准确率，同时对图像质量的影响有限。

Conclusion: AnchorMark通过利用旋转同步性这一潜在空间性质，以训练自由的同步锚点策略有效解决了反向水印在旋转及复合后处理攻击下的鲁棒性问题，在不牺牲图像质量的前提下大幅提升水印提取准确率。

Abstract: Inversion-based watermarking embeds watermark payloads directly into the generative process, avoiding a separate post-hoc image-domain embedding stage while preserving the native visual fidelity of synthesized images. However, existing methods remain vulnerable to compound lossy post-processing, particularly when rotation is involved, as it disrupts the spatial correspondence required for latent-space decoding. To overcome this limitation, we introduce AnchorMark, a training-free, robust inversion-based watermarking. We uncover a latent-space property termed Rotation Synchrony: image-domain rotations and their counterparts in the recovered initial latent share the same angle. Building on this property, AnchorMark embeds a synchronization anchor in the central region of the initial latent, enabling accurate estimation and correction of the rotation angle during extraction. Experiments show that AnchorMark substantially improves bit accuracy under rotation and combined attacks, with limited impact on image quality.

</details>


### [297] [Revisiting the Adversarial Robustness of Graph-Based Traffic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27604)
*Qingzhao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文指出图神经网络的交通流预测鲁棒性研究此前使用了不现实的威胁模型和非定向目标。作者提出一种物理感知的、针对特定链路或路线的靶向攻击，并引入基于物理信息的检测-缓解防御框架，将检测器输出作为特征输入到加固后的预测器中，在15个模型-数据集设置中的13个上优于对抗训练，且对未见攻击泛化更好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往针对图AI交通预测的鲁棒性评估基于不现实的威胁模型（如全知攻击者、全局范数受限扰动）和非定向目标，导致攻防研究脱离实际。实际场景中攻击者知识有限、只操控少数传感器，且攻击应定位到特定链路/路线以造成局部破坏（如错误到达时间或重新规划路线），这一靶向场景尚未被充分探索，现有防御（如对抗训练）对物理感知攻击迁移性差。

Method: (1) 提出物理感知的靶向攻击，攻击者拥有有限模型知识，仅监控和操控少量道路传感器，攻击定位于特定链路/路线以模仿真实拥堵；(2) 将鲁棒性重新定义为检测问题，设计一个基于物理信息的检测器，其输出作为额外输入特征馈入加固后的预测器（forecaster），并在固定预测器的条件下针对自适应攻击进行对抗训练；(3) 在多种模型架构和基准数据集上进行评估。

Result: 物理感知攻击使目标链路的误差放大数倍且网络全局误差几乎不变；针对范数受限扰动调优的对抗训练几乎无法防御该攻击；所提出的检测-缓解防御在15个模型-数据集设置中的13个上优于针对物理攻击本身做对抗训练的模型，并对留存攻击（held-out attack）取得了最大优势，而干净样本上的性能几乎无损。

Conclusion: 研究强调：评估AI对抗攻击必须置于应用特定的约束条件下，才能真实反映其安全影响。将鲁棒性重构为检测问题并引入物理先验的防御框架比传统对抗训练更有效，尤其是在攻击类型多样、未见攻击泛化要求高的场景中。

Abstract: Traffic forecasting by graph-based AI is a critical component of intelligent transportation systems, motivating security research on robustness to malicious sensor readings. We argue that prior robustness evaluations are largely shaped by unrealistic threat models and untargeted objectives, so both attacks and defenses must be revisited. We study a practical adversary with limited model knowledge and the ability to monitor and manipulate only a few road sensors. More importantly, practical attacks can be localized to specific links or routes, causing incorrect estimated arrival times or unnecessary rerouting while leaving the broader network largely unaffected. This targeted setting remains underexplored, and defenses such as adversarial training do not transfer well from the norm-bounded attacks they train on to structurally different, physics-aware attacks that mimic genuine congestion. We therefore reframe robustness as a detection problem, introducing a learned physics-informed detector whose output is fed to a hardened forecaster as an input feature and trained against adaptive attacks with the forecaster fixed. We evaluate across a variety of model architectures and benchmarks. The physics-aware attack multiplies target-link error several-fold while the network-wide error barely moves, and adversarial training, tuned to norm-bounded perturbations, barely dents it. Our detection--mitigation defense improves even on adversarial training hardened against the physics-aware attack itself, on $13$ of $15$ model--dataset settings and by the widest margin on a held-out attack, at near-zero clean cost. The results emphasize the need to examine abstracted AI adversarial attacks under application-specific constraints to assess their true security impacts.

</details>


### [298] [Strategy Phasing of Cyber Attacks on Digital Substations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27661)
*Akila Herath,Chen-Ching Liu,Junho Hong,Kuchan Park*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出SubCASP，一种基于隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）的方法，融合入侵检测系统（IDS）数据日志，推断IEC 61850数字变电站网络攻击的当前阶段、下一阶段及回溯攻击路径，以支持缓解措施的部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的入侵检测系统（IDS）通常只能标记孤立的攻击症状，缺乏对攻击阶段的上下文感知，无法为缓解措施的部署提供足够的攻击阶段信息支持。而针对IEC 61850数字变电站的网络安全攻击往往是基于多阶段策略精心构造的。

Method: 本文提出SubCASP方法：基于ATT&CK威胁建模推导攻击阶段，使用隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）融合IDS数据日志，以推断当前攻击阶段、预测下一攻击阶段并重构回溯攻击路径。模型在可复现的攻击图数据集上进行训练与评估。

Result: 测试结果表明，SubCASP在各种IDS可观测性水平以及IDS数据日志缺失的场景下均表现出鲁棒性。

Conclusion: SubCASP通过HMM融合IDS日志，能够有效为数字变电站攻击提供阶段上下文感知，支持更精准的缓解措施部署，并在数据不完整或观测受限条件下保持稳健性能。

Abstract: Digital substations that comply with IEC 61850 have improved the operational efficiency of modern power systems. However, adversaries can abuse IEC 61850 communication to manipulate circuit breaker operations in substations, which can result in severe system impacts. These cyber attacks are crafted based on broader multi-phase strategies. The existing intrusion detection systems (IDSs) often flag only isolated symptoms. Thus, there is a lack of context in the attack phase to support the deployment of mitigation measures. This paper proposes Substation Cyber Attack Strategy Phasing (SubCASP), a Hidden Markov Model(HMM)- based method that fuses IDS data logs to infer the current attack phase, next attack phase, and retrospective attack path. The attack phases are derived from an ATT&CK-based threat modeling. The SubCASP model is trained and evaluated on a reproducible attack-graph dataset. Test results are presented to demonstrate the robustness of SubCASP for various IDS observability levels and missing IDS data logs scenarios.

</details>


### [299] [Distributed Point Functions and Function Secret Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27696)
*Elette Boyle,Niv Gilboa,Yuval Ishai,Peter Scholl*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对分布式点函数（DPF）及其推广——函数秘密共享（FSS）进行了综述，涵盖其定义、构造方法和应用场景，包括私有信息检索、匿名消息传递、带预处理的安全计算以及伪随机相关生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPF作为一种轻量级密码学原语，能够实现权重为1的秘密向量的压缩加性共享，在众多应用（如PIR、匿名通信、安全计算等）中展现出强大的实用价值。对该领域进行系统性综述有助于研究者理解DPF的现状、发展方向及其与FSS之间的联系。

Method: 本文采用综述性研究方法，系统梳理了DPF的定义、构造方案及应用场景，并进一步讨论了DPF向函数秘密共享（FSS）的扩展，说明FSS如何支持更丰富的函数类别，从而将DPF的大部分应用推广到通用情形。

Result: 文章总结了DPF的核心定义与多种构造方法，回顾了其在私有信息检索、匿名消息传递、预处理安全计算和伪随机相关生成器等领域的应用，并阐述了FSS作为DPF泛化形式在支持更复杂函数类方面的扩展及其对应用的影响。

Conclusion: DPF是一种结构精巧且用途广泛的密码学原语，其向FSS的推广为更丰富的函数类提供了高效秘密共享方案，使得大多数DPF应用能够自然扩展到FSS框架下。

Abstract: A distributed point function (DPF) is a cryptographic primitive that enables compressed additive sharing of a secret weight-1 vector (equivalently, a point function) across two or more parties. The appealing lightweight structure of DPF constructions has enabled a wide range of applications. These include private information retrieval, anonymous messaging, secure computation with preprocessing, and pseudorandom correlation generators for expanding small correlated seeds into large pseudorandom instances of cryptographic correlations.
  In this article, we survey definitions, constructions, and applications of DPFs. We also discuss the extension of DPF to function secret sharing (FSS), which generalizes point functions to support richer function classes. Efficient FSS schemes yield a similar generalization for most of the applications of DPFs.

</details>


### [300] [CHARGE: Leveraging CWE Hierarchies for Hardware Security SystemVerilog Assertion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27776)
*Xiao Tan,Cynthia Sturton*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出CHARGE框架，利用CWEs和大型语言模型（LLMs）自动生成未验证RTL模块的安全属性，利用CWE条目的层级特性提高安全关键资产识别精度，避免依赖可信设计规范。在Hack@DAC18/19/21开源SoC设计中评估，检测到42个已知bug中的27个，并在OpenPiton SoC上生成了可运行、非空洞的SVA，甚至发现了新的bug。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RTL安全属性生成通常依赖可信设计规范，且需要大量人工工程努力。该工作旨在自动化生成安全属性，减少人工干预，同时提高安全关键资产识别的准确性。

Method: 利用CWE条目的层级结构（hierarchical nature）作为推理过程的核心，结合LLM识别未验证RTL模块中的安全关键资产，进而推断期望的安全行为并生成安全属性。

Result: 在Hack@DAC18/19/21上检测到42个已知bugs中的27个；Hack@DAC21 OpenPiton SoC上89%的SVA在JasperGold FPV中可运行，92.2%非空；正确编写了3个手动属性写错的bug的属性；发现了一个此前未识别的新bug。

Conclusion: CHARGE展示了利用LLM和CWE层级知识自动化生成RTL安全属性的可行性与有效性，能发现新bug，为硬件安全验证提供了一条无需可信规范、低人工成本的路径。

Abstract: This paper presents CHARGE, an automated framework for generating security properties for unverified RTL modules using CWEs and large language models (LLMs). The hallmark is a reasoning process that leverages the hierarchical nature of CWE entries to improve accuracy when identifying security-critical assets in unverified RTL modules. As a result, the approach can infer expected security behaviors and generate properties from identified assets and CWE semantics, avoiding the need for trusted design specifications and reducing manual engineering effort. We evaluate the framework on the Hack@DAC18, 19, and 21 open source SoC designs using OpenAI's GPT-4.1. CHARGE detects 27 of 42 known bugs in these designs. For Hack@DAC21 OpenPiton SoC, 89% of the generated SVAs run in Cadence JasperGold FPV, and 92.2% are non-vacuous. We compare to an open-source, manually written set of properties for these designs and find that CHARGE correctly writes properties for three bugs in which the manually written properties were incorrect. In addition, CHARGE-generated properties identify a new bug in the Hack@DAC21 OpenPiton SoC that was not previously identified.

</details>


### [301] [Adaptive Security at the Edge for 6G-Enabled Healthcare IoT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27858)
*Ijaz Ahmad,Ijaz Ahmad,Erkki Harjula*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: NANOEDGEGUARD是一个面向医疗物联网边缘网关的内核平面闭环控制器，通过内核流量控制钩子执行可审计的多层速率策略，在突发流量下相比用户态防火墙基线将99分位报警RTT降低13.3%，并较无约束场景减少46%的过量突发流量接纳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗物联网服务依赖边缘网关转发常规遥测数据和罕见但时间关键的报警消息，即使是短暂流量突发也可能放大最坏情况延迟并干扰紧急消息传输，而静态防火墙规则或用户态控制回路无法满足快速执行与可审计性的需求。

Method: 提出NANOEDGEGUARD，一种运行在内核平面的闭环控制器。它观察边缘每源流量强度，利用内核流量控制钩子执行可审计的多层速率策略；相比静态防火墙规则或用户态控制回路，该方法侧重快速执行并通过迟滞机制显式恢复，同时记录策略转换用于审计。

Result: 在搭载MQTT代理的Raspberry Pi网关及两个产生生命体征、报警和定时突发的ESP32端点上实验：自适应内核平面速率控制相比用户态防火墙基线将99分位报警RTT降低13.3%，且保持与无约束级别相当的RTT；相比无约束场景，过量接纳突发流量减少46%。

Conclusion: 早期的验证结果表明，在网关处进行自适应、可审计的速率执行能够提升医疗物联网的韧性，且该方法可在未来边缘智能中扩展为按需策略部署。

Abstract: Healthcare IoT services increasingly rely on edge gateways to relay routine telemetry and deliver rare but timecritical alarms. Even short traffic bursts can inflate worstcase delay and interfere with urgent messages. We present NANOEDGEGUARD, a kernel-plane closed-loop controller that observes per-source traffic intensity at the edge and enforces an auditable, multi-tier rate policy using in-kernel traffic-control hooks. Unlike static firewall rules or user-space control loops, our design prioritizes fast actuation and explicit recovery through hysteresis, and it records policy transitions for auditability. Using a Raspberry Pi gateway hosting an MQTT broker and two ESP32 endpoints generating vitals, alarms, and a timed burst, we show that adaptive kernel-plane rate control reduces the 99th-percentile alarm RTT by 13.3% compared to a user-space firewall baseline while maintaining no-enforcement-level RTT, and it reduces excess admitted burst traffic by 46% compared to no enforcement. These early results indicate that adaptive, auditable enforcement at the gateway can improve resilience for healthcare IoT, and it can be extended toward on-demand policy deployment in future edge intelligence.

</details>


### [302] [Don't Trust the AI Ecosystem: Analyzing Privacy Leakage in Compromised Open-Source Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27886)
*Jin-Seong Kim,Han-Ju Lee,Seok-Won Hong,Takeshi Takahashi,Chansu Han,Tomohiro Morikawa,Seok-Hwan Choi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: GradLock是一种训练时注入攻击方法，通过将敏感训练数据直接嵌入模型参数中，使得攻击者无需保留训练环境访问权限即可从最终模型中提取像素级完美的数据，并具有极强的隐蔽性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的模型反演（MI）攻击主要依赖训练后优化来恢复私有数据，但受限于目标模型的泛化瓶颈，通常只能恢复通用特征而非特定身份，尤其在高维数据集上效果不佳。作者旨在设计一种更强大的训练时注入攻击方法，克服传统MI攻击的固有局限。

Method: GradLock采用三项核心技术：(1) 供应链劫持场景下的训练时注入；(2) 无状态确定性索引（stateless deterministic indexing）建立隔离数据保险库；(3) 动态梯度锁定（dynamic gradient locking）防止载荷在优化过程中退化。攻击者将敏感数据编码到模型参数中，即使不再访问训练环境也能从最终模型提取数据。

Result: 在MNIST、Imagenette和CelebA数据集上，GradLock实现了近乎无损的重建（SSIM约1.0）和即时提取（<1.0秒）。相比现有训练时注入方法，对量化、剪枝和微调等标准部署优化表现出更强的鲁棒性。用户部署研究表明93.3%的参与者未能检测到恶意逻辑。

Conclusion: GradLock揭示了一个严重的AI供应链安全盲区：训练时注入攻击可以实现高保真、高隐蔽性的数据窃取，且难以被标准部署防护手段和人工检测所识别，对现代AI供应链安全构成重大威胁。

Abstract: Existing model inversion (MI) attacks predominantly rely on post-training optimization to recover private data from model outputs. However, these methods are fundamentally constrained by the target model's generalization bottleneck, often yielding generic features rather than specific identities, particularly on high-dimensional datasets. In this paper, we introduce GradLock, a novel training-time injection attack that stealthily injects sensitive training data directly into the model parameters. Operating within a compromised supply chain context, GradLock leverages stateless deterministic indexing to establish isolated data vaults and employs dynamic gradient locking to prevent payload degradation during the optimization process. This mechanism allows the adversary to extract pixel-perfect data from the final model without retaining access to the training environment. Extensive experiments on MNIST, Imagenette, and CelebA demonstrate that GradLock achieves near-lossless reconstruction (SSIM ~ 1.0) and instant extraction (< 1.0s). Compared to existing training-time injection methods, our approach exhibits superior robustness against standard deployment optimizations, including quantization, pruning, and fine-tuning. Furthermore, a user deployment study reveals that 93.3% of participants failed to detect the malicious logic, highlighting a severe blind spot in the security of modern AI supply chains.

</details>


### [303] [Benign on Label, Malicious by Design: Clean-Label Dormant-to-Activated Backdoor via Machine Unlearning with Removable Camouflage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27936)
*Dongdong Zhao,Can Li,Xiang Yao,Fan He,Qihang Ge,Baogang Song*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于双生成器学习的干净标签"遗忘激活后门"框架，通过双层优化同时建立持久潜在关联和可移除抑制，实现训练后保持休眠、机器学习遗忘后才被激活的后门攻击，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-10上验证了较低的先遗忘攻击成功率与较强的后遗忘激活能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后门攻击在植入后立即生效，容易被检测暴露。虽然利用机器遗忘激活的休眠后门可以避免这种行为暴露，但现有方法难以在干净标签约束和现实遗忘请求下，同时实现低的先遗忘攻击成功率和强的后遗忘激活效果，关键在于需要同时建立持久潜在关联与可移除抑制。

Method: 提出基于双生成器学习的干净标签遗忘激活后门框架，将其形式化为双层优化问题：通过模拟潜在后门建立与机器遗忘过程，交替学习（1）建立潜在"触发器到目标"关联的样本特定触发器，以及（2）提供可移除抑制的标签一致伪装样本。当小部分伪装样本被遗忘后，抑制被解除，休眠后门被激活。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet-10上，与代表性后门基线相比，该方法在多种遗忘算法下均保持更低的先遗忘攻击成功率，同时实现更强的后遗忘激活效果。

Conclusion: 通过协调持久潜在关联与可移除抑制，可以在干净标签和现实删除约束下实现可靠的"休眠到激活"转换，证明了这类高隐蔽性后门攻击的可行性与威胁性。

Abstract: Existing backdoor attacks often become effective immediately after backdoor implantation and may therefore be exposed before exploitation. Machine unlearning activated dormant backdoors mitigate such behavioral exposure by remaining inactive after training and becoming effective only after selected training records are unlearned. However, existing methods struggle to simultaneously achieve a low pre-unlearning attack success rate and strong post-unlearning activation under clean-label constraints and realistic unlearning requests. Achieving this transition requires jointly establishing a persistent latent association and a removable suppressive influence. To address this challenge, we propose a clean-label unlearning-activated backdoor framework based on dual-generator learning and formulate it as a bilevel optimization problem: By simulating latent backdoor establishment and machine unlearning, the framework alternately learns sample-specific triggers that establish a latent trigger-to-target association and label-consistent camouflage samples that provide removable suppression. Once a small subset of camouflage samples is unlearned, the suppression is lifted and the dormant backdoor is activated. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-10 show that our method maintains lower pre-unlearning attack success rates while achieving stronger post-unlearning activation across multiple unlearning algorithms than representative backdoor baselines. These results demonstrate that reliable dormancy-to-activation transitions can be achieved by coordinating a persistent latent association with removable suppression under clean-label and realistic deletion constraints.

</details>


### [304] [Safeguards Based on Copyable Context Cannot Provide Reliable Safety for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27951)
*Pingyu Wu,Lingyao Zhu,Weiming Zhang,Nenghai Yu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文论证了大语言模型安全防护面临一个基本困境：模型在知晓答案用途之前就必须决定是否回答，而攻击者可以模仿合法请求。当关于下游使用的证据可复制时，模型对攻击者的辅助存在一个确切的数学下限，由此推导出"有用能力、可靠安全、开放访问"三者不可兼得的安全三难困境。作者提出可信凭据可提供不可复制的下游使用证据来补充现有防护，并给出了消除该下限所需的更强条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型安全防护机制存在根本性缺陷：模型在回答前无法真正知晓答案的最终用途。对于双重用途（dual-use）任务，同一个回答既能帮助授权的专业用户，也可能被攻击者滥用，且攻击者可以轻易模仿合法用户的请求模式和对话历史，导致现有基于提示词内容的安全防护容易被绕过。作者希望从理论层面揭示这一问题的本质，并提出可行的补充方案。

Method: 作者采用理论分析结合实证验证的方法：(1) 将模型释放的能力与关于下游使用的证据分离建模；(2) 在证据可复制（copyable）的条件下，推导出攻击者获得模型辅助的精确最坏情况下限（worst-case floor）；(3) 由此证明"有用能力-可靠安全-开放访问"三难困境；(4) 提出可信凭据（trusted credential）机制，将不可复制的信息引入安全决策，以更准确地预测真实下游使用；(5) 通过双重用途评估、自适应攻击和已部署的可信访问项目来验证条件的实践相关性。

Result: 证明了在证据可复制的前提下，模型对攻击者提供的辅助存在一个无法消除的理论下限；安全三难困境（有用能力、可靠安全、开放访问不可兼得）在理论上成立；可信凭据可以降低但无法完全消除该下限，需要更强的条件（更强的不可复制性保证）才能完全消除；实证研究支持了这些理论条件的实际意义。

Conclusion: 大语言模型的双重用途安全本质上是一个信息不对称问题。由于任何可复制的请求信息都可以被攻击者模仿，仅靠内容层面的防护无法同时保证能力有用性、安全可靠性和系统开放性。引入硬性不可复制的可信凭据（如身份认证）是弥补这一缺陷的可行方向，但需要更强的保证条件才能真正消除攻击者利用模型的下限。这一理论框架为理解和设计更安全的AI防御体系提供了基础。

Abstract: Large language model safeguards decide whether to answer before seeing how an answer will be used. This creates a basic problem for dual-use tasks: the same answer can help an authorized professional or an attacker, while an attacker can imitate a benign request and interaction history. We separate the capability released by the model from the evidence available about downstream use. When that evidence is copyable, we derive the exact worst-case floor on attacker assistance while preserving useful answers. The result yields a safety trilemma: Useful Capability, Reliable Safety, and Open Access cannot coexist. We then show how a trusted credential can complement existing safeguards by adding hard-to-copy information that predicts actual downstream use, and identify the stronger condition needed to eliminate the floor. Evidence from dual-use evaluations, adaptive attacks, and deployed trusted-access programs supports the practical relevance of these conditions.

</details>


### [305] [Driving up Inference Energy on SNNs: Per-Sample and Universal Sponge Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27990)
*Spyridon Raptis,Haralampos-G. Stratigopoulos*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次针对原生事件驱动的二进制输入脉冲神经网络（SNNs）提出海绵攻击（sponge attack），通过两种攻击模型（逐样本攻击和通用攻击）增加推理时的尖峰活动与突触工作量（SynOps），导致能耗膨胀，同时保持分类正确率，揭示了SNNs在能效优势下隐藏的安全漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNNs因其稀疏二值尖峰通信和能效优势被广泛用于边缘设备，但此前的工作仅关注输入空间中的逐样本效率攻击（主要在速率编码设置下）。作者希望首次将海绵攻击扩展到原生事件驱动的二进制输入上，并研究更实际的通用攻击威胁，因为这类攻击难以通过基于正确性的监控检测，却可导致持续部署的边缘系统电池耗尽。

Method: 提出两类攻击：(1) 逐样本海绵攻击：通过基于梯度的优化为每个输入定制对抗性尖峰序列；(2) 通用海绵攻击：离线计算一个固定的二进制扰动，通过XOR应用于所有后续输入，无需逐输入优化。在NMNIST、SHD和IBM DVS Gesture三个数据集上的三个SNN模型上评估。

Result: 逐样本攻击将每次推理的SynOps提升1.5-2.6倍，同时在至少98%的样本上保持预测类别不变；通用攻击将SynOps提升1.09-1.24倍。映射到Loihi-1能耗，每次推理的开销为14μJ到13.24mJ。

Conclusion: 原生事件驱动的SNNs容易受到实用的输入空间效率攻击；可复用的通用扰动能在持续部署的边缘系统中累积为可观的电池消耗，构成实际部署威胁。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) communicate through sparse binary spike events rather than dense activations, enabling energy-efficient inference on neuromorphic hardware and motivating their use in always-on, battery-powered edge systems. We show that this same efficiency advantage creates a distinct security risk: sponge attacks can increase inference-time spike activity and synaptic workload, inflating energy consumption while remaining difficult to detect through correctness-based monitoring alone. Prior input-space efficiency attacks on SNNs have focused on per-sample optimization, primarily in rate-coded settings. We extend this threat to native event-based binary inputs and study two attack models. First, we develop a per-sample sponge attack that crafts a custom adversarial spike train for each input via gradient-based optimization. This attack increases per-inference SynOps by 1.5-2.6x on three SNN models for the NMNIST, SHD, and IBM DVS Gesture datasets, while preserving the predicted class on at least 98% of evaluated samples. Second, to the best of our knowledge, we introduce the first universal sponge attack for native event-based SNN inputs: a fixed binary perturbation computed offline and applied via XOR to all subsequent inputs. Although weaker, it still inflates SynOps by 1.09-1.24x across all three datasets and represents a more realistic deployment threat because it requires no per-input optimization. Mapping SynOp inflation to estimated Loihi-1 energy yields per-inference overheads from 14 $μ$J to 13.24 mJ. These results show that native event-based SNNs are vulnerable to practical input-space efficiency attacks, and that reusable universal perturbations can accumulate into meaningful battery drain in continuously deployed edge systems.

</details>


### [306] [Temporal Poisoning: Clean-Label Backdoors via Event Redistribution in SNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28075)
*Roberto Riaño,Gorka Abad,Stjepan Picek,Aitor Urbieta*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次在脉冲神经网络（SNN）上提出并评估了清洁标签时序中毒后门攻击。该方法仅对目标类别训练流施加固定的时间戳变换，不改变标签，并保持逐像素、逐极性事件计数不变。在三个神经形态数据集及卷积和Transformer两类受害模型上，最强配置下攻击成功率（ASR）达到1.00。文章还分析了毒药预算与触发形状的影响，并评估了现有后门防御在SNN上的表现——折叠时间轴的防御天然失效，特征空间方法仅在特定场景有效。作者提出的基于逐步事件质量的免模型检测器可检测所评估的时序变换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SNN后门攻击研究主要假设脏标签投毒（将触发样本重新标记为攻击者选择的类别），而清洁标签场景在SNN和神经形态事件数据上尚未被探索。作者旨在弥补这一空白，研究在标签不变的前提下，仅通过对目标类别训练流施加时序变换是否足以实现有效的后门攻击，并评估其隐蔽性与现有防御的有效性。

Method: 攻击方法：对目标类别训练样本施加固定的时间戳变换（temporal transformation），保持标签不变。该变换精确保持逐像素、逐极性的事件计数，使得时序聚合（temporal aggregation）后清洁样本与触发样本无法区分，但SNN处理的事件序列已被改变。评估方面：在三个神经形态数据集上对卷积和Transformer两类SNN受害者进行攻击；通过毒药预算（poison-budget）和触发形状（trigger-shape）消融实验分析攻击特性；将多种已建立的后门防御适配到脉冲模型进行评估；提出基于逐步事件质量（per-step event mass）的免模型检测器。

Result: 在最强配置下，攻击在三个数据集和两类受害模型上均达到ASR=1.00。消融实验揭示了毒药预算和触发形状对攻击效果的影响。防御评估显示：折叠时间轴后再检测的防御因构造原因而完全失效（盲区）；特征空间方法仅在部分设置下能检测到毒药。作者提出的免模型检测器能够检测所评估的所有时序变换，展示了速率折叠防御的局限性以及攻击隐蔽性的边界。

Conclusion: 首次证明了清洁标签后门攻击在SNN和神经形态事件数据上的可行性与有效性，填补了该领域的研究空白。时序维度上的篡改能够绕过依赖事件计数的传统防御，但基于逐步事件质量的检测器可以识别此类攻击，表明攻击存在可探测的边界，为未来SNN后门攻防研究提供了方向。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks on Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have primarily assumed dirty-label poisoning, in which triggered training samples are relabeled to an attacker-selected class. We study clean-label temporal poisoning, where a fixed timestamp transformation is applied only to the target-class training streams, leaving their labels unchanged. The transformation preserves the per-pixel, per-polarity event count exactly, making clean and triggered samples identical after temporal aggregation while altering the sequence processed by the SNN. Across three neuromorphic datasets and both convolutional and transformer-based victims, the attack reaches an ASR of 1.00 in the strongest configurations. We analyze the attack through poison-budget and trigger-shape ablations and evaluate established backdoor defenses adapted to spiking models. Defenses that collapse the time axis before inspection are blind by construction, while feature-space methods detect the poison only in selected settings. Our model-free detector, based on per-step event mass, detects the evaluated temporal transformations, demonstrating both the limitation of rate-collapsed defenses and the boundary of the attack's stealth. To our knowledge, this is the first clean-label backdoor attack evaluated on SNNs and neuromorphic event data.

</details>


### [307] [Checking Information Flow in Cloud-based IoT Access Control Policies (Extended Version)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28088)
*Lorenzo Ceragioli,Letterio Galletta,Edoardo Lunati*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文分析AWS IoT Core的访问控制策略，通过信息流图识别设备间非预期信息流动导致的安全漏洞，并利用SMT求解器构建有限图表示以支持信息流验证，实现了名为IOT:POKER的工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在IoT环境中，设备具有不同信任级别或分属不同子系统，仅单独验证权限配置不足以发现安全漏洞，因为跨设备/子系统的信息流动可能造成非预期泄露。因此需要从信息流角度分析访问控制策略。

Method: 形式上建模AWS IoT Core的组件，定义信息流图以刻画访问控制策略允许的设备间通信；利用SMT求解器构建图的有限表示，从而支持设备间信息流的自动化验证；将方法实现为工具IOT:POKER。

Result: 在真实场景及多个真实世界策略上评估了IOT:POKER工具，验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: 通过在策略层面验证设备间信息流而非仅验证单一权限，能够更全面地识别IoT云平台访问控制配置中的安全漏洞。

Abstract: Many cloud providers for IoT technologies offer access control mechanisms whose proper configuration is critical for security. However, verifying permissions in isolation is insufficient in a setting where devices have different levels of trust or are compartmentalised in various subsystems. This work analyses IoT access control policies to identify potential security vulnerabilities from unwanted information flow between devices. To this end, we formally model AWS IoT Core's components and define an information flow graph to capture the communication among devices permitted by the access control policies. We build a finite representation of the graph by leveraging an SMT solver, thus enabling the verification of information flow between devices. We implement our approach in a tool called IOT:POKER, and assess it on a realistic scenario and several real-world policies.

</details>


### [308] [Agent Harness Distillation: Inference-Time Harness Extraction and Exploitation in Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28147)
*Yu Cui,Wuli Yang,Yirui Shi,Junhao Xia,Hui Jiang,Lei Gao,Chenfu Bao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出Agent Harness Distillation (AHD)框架，研究自主多智能体系统（AMAS）中推理时harness（推理管线）的知识产权泄露风险。AHD通过黑盒交互从目标智能体中提取推理时harness能力，并在真实AMAS上展示了显著的IP泄露风险，同时提出基于欺骗的防御方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究已探讨静态多智能体系统的IP泄露问题，但自主多智能体系统（AMAS）中，harness行为在推理过程中动态涌现，其知识产权泄露风险尚未被研究。推理时harness的构建需要大量工程和计算资源，是重要的知识产权，需要系统性评估其安全风险。

Method: AHD框架包含两个阶段：(1) 预蒸馏阶段：通过黑盒交互从目标智能体的响应中推断推理时harness行为，构建初始harness；(2) 后蒸馏阶段：迭代精炼初始harness，使其与目标智能体的行为模式对齐。此外提出基于欺骗的防御策略。

Result: 在多个骨干LLM上的真实AMAS实验中，AHD有效提取了推理时harness能力，揭示了显著的IP泄露风险。基于欺骗的防御方法在降低harness提取有效性的同时保持了受保护智能体的效用。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了AMAS中此前未被充分探索的安全威胁——推理时harness的知识产权泄露，引入了harness提取的新安全问题及量化评估框架，并提供了有效的防御方向。

Abstract: Autonomous multi-agent systems (AMAS) built on large language models (LLMs), such as Hermes, increasingly rely on inference-time harnesses to coordinate reasoning and action. Constructing these harnesses requires substantial engineering effort and computational resources, as they are iteratively optimized over a combinatorial search space while co-evolving with the underlying LLM. Inference-time harnesses therefore constitute valuable intellectual property (IP).
