Evaluating 18 representative general-purpose, medical-domain, and pathology-oriented MLLMs, we observe substantial limitations even in advanced models on fine-grained visual tasks across multiscale pathology images. PathVU provides a reproducible basis for developing and evaluating pathology MLLMs with explicit multiscale visual understanding.

</details>


### [441] [Paying for Honesty Without Knowing the Truth: Reputation-Penalty Design for LLM Marketplace Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28330)
*Mingdai Yang,Shicheng Fan,Kejing Yu,Duohao Wang,Li Sun,Hao Peng,Philip S. Yu,Zhiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CARP声誉惩罚机制与SPARC代码门控反思机制，以解决LLM代理商家在缺乏真实信息下虚构产品属性的问题。CARP利用噪声容忍死区和状态依赖惩罚强度，无需产品级真实标签即可抑制低分说谎者的销量；SPARC作为字节级代码门控反思工具，将"惩罚代价"转化为行为约束，实验表明LLM商家在撒谎无代价时虚构，在撒谎有代价时自我约束，实现接近完美信息基线的消费者福利。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理日益充当自主商家并自行撰写产品列表，在竞争压力下会捏造属性以赢得销售；即使被指示保持诚实，多数模型的商家仍大量虚构属性。平台显而易见的补救措施——逐条核实声明与真相——不可行，因为平台只能观察到有噪声、有偏的投诉信号，永远无法获取真实信息。因此需要一个无需真实信息、且能抵御策略性博弈的声誉惩罚机制。

Method: CARP包含两个关键设计：(1) 死区(deadband)机制，对投诉噪声进行宽容处理，避免误伤诚实商家；(2) 状态依赖的惩罚强度(state-dependent severity)，以抵消由声誉驱动的检测侵蚀(detection erosion)。CARP不依赖产品级真实信息，仅基于带噪声的有偏投诉信号运行。与之配套的SPARC是一种字节级干净的代码门控反思机制(byte-clean code-gated reflection)，将制造商的虚假行为与实际销售损失直接关联，使惩罚从"感觉到的惩罚"变为"行为上有约束力的惩罚"。

Result: CARP在无需真实信息的情况下，将低分说谎者的销量压低以保护消费者，同时不误伤诚实商家。与SPARC配对时，相对于完美信息预言机，CARP收窄了大部分消费者福利差距，并在对比的所有策略中取得最佳福利。SPARC证明该惩罚在行为上具有约束力：LLM商家在撒谎无成本时会虚构，但在虚构导致销售损失时能自我约束——这是一种自利性响应而非合规行为。此类现象跨模型可复现，并有置信区间支持。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了惩罚门控的自我修正推理(penalty-gated self-correction reasoning)是LLM商家从"自由虚构"转向"约束自我"的关键机制。CARP+SPARC的组合方案证明了在市场监督中即使缺乏真值信息，也能通过巧妙的声誉设计与行为绑定机制实现接近理想监督的效果，为LLM自主代理的诚信监管提供了切实可行的路径。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act as autonomous merchants that write their own product listings, and under competitive pressure, they fabricate attributes to win sales. Even under instructions to be honest, they fabricate attributes in a majority of listings across models. A platform's obvious remedy---verifying each claim against the truth---is unavailable, because it observes only a noisy, biased complaint signal, never the ground truth. We design CARP, a reputation-penalty mechanism with a deadband that forgives complaint noise and a state-dependent severity that counters reputation-driven detection erosion. CARP requires no product-level ground truth and is robust to strategic gaming. CARP protects consumers by suppressing the sales volume of low-rated liars while sparing honest sellers. Paired with SPARC, it closes most of the consumer-welfare gap relative to a perfect-information oracle, without ever accessing the truth. It also achieves the best welfare of the policies we compare. We further show that this felt penalty becomes behaviorally binding through SPARC, a byte-clean code-gated reflection mechanism: LLM merchants fabricate when lying is free but restrain themselves when fabrication costs them sales, a self-interested response rather than compliance. We trace this distinction to penalty-gated self-correction reasoning, and observe the binding across models, with supporting confidence intervals.

</details>


### [442] [Correcting What You Cannot See: Credit Assignment for Perception Distillation in Multimodal Reasoners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28336)
*Feng Xiong,Leyan Xue,Hongyu Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出感知-纠正蒸馏（PCD），一种无需标注的自蒸馏方法，通过下游失败和学生-教师分歧作为互补证据，以软AND门的形式识别可纠正的感知失败，从而提升多模态推理器的蒸馏质量。实验表明PCD在八个基准上显著优于原有on-policy蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的on-policy蒸馏虽然为多模态推理器提供密集监督，但其轨迹级奖励无法区分失败究竟源于感知环节还是后续推理环节。已有的感知成功率（PSR）估计方法存在歧义：低成功率既可能反映感知能力不足，也可能反映推理困难。因此需要一个能够准确识别可纠正感知失败的方法，避免将推理困难误判为感知问题而进行错误的蒸馏强化。

Method: PCD通过两个互补线索识别可纠正的感知失败：(1) 下游推理失败作为直接证据，(2) 教师-学生预测分歧作为间接证据。二者的乘积构成一个软AND门，仅当两个线索同时存在时才强化蒸馏信号。该规则通过贝叶斯证据组合推导，并证明了乘法是唯一满足当任一证据缺失时门值消失的归一化双线性门函数。PCD还采用感知-推理分离的rollout策略和均值保持权重，确保推理目标不受干扰。

Result: 在八个基准上，PCD将8B→2B蒸馏的宏平均从OPD的44.50提升至47.28，将32B→8B蒸馏从56.94提升至61.22。在匹配的2B消融实验中，移除PCD和分离rollout分别导致留出集平均下降2.22和0.88分。

Conclusion: 有效的多模态蒸馏不仅取决于教师预测什么，还取决于何时该将感知作为纠正目标。PCD通过软AND门准确识别感知纠正的时机，显著提升蒸馏效果，为多模态推理蒸馏提供了新的设计原则。

Abstract: On-policy distillation provides dense supervision for multimodal reasoners, but its trajectory-level reward cannot determine whether a failed answer arose from perception or subsequent reasoning. Perception Success Rate (PSR), estimated from multiple reasonings sharing one perception, remains ambiguous because low success conflates perceptual insufficiency with reasoning difficulty. We introduce \textbf{Perception-Correction Distillation (PCD)}, a label-free method that identifies correctable perception failures using downstream failure and teacher--student disagreement as complementary witnesses. Their product, , forms a soft AND gate that strengthens distillation only when both witnesses are present. We motivate this rule through Bayesian evidence combination and show that multiplication is the unique normalized bilinear gate that vanishes when either witness is absent. PCD uses separated perception--reasoning rollouts and mean-preserving weights, leaving the reasoning objective unchanged. Across eight benchmarks, PCD improves the 8B 2B macro average from 44.50 with OPD to 47.28 and the 32B 8B result from 56.94 to 61.22. In matched 2B ablations, removing PCD and separated rollout reduces held-out average by 2.22 and 0.88 points, respectively. Effective multimodal distillation therefore depends not only on what the teacher predicts, but also on identifying when perception is the appropriate target of correction.

</details>


### [443] [How Benchmarks Mis-Score Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28367)
*Zihan Dong,Zhiyuan Ma,Zekun Wang,Yunqing Li,Zirou Liu,Ruixuan Deng,Qishi Zhan,Rui Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套针对计算机使用代理（CUA）评估可靠性的框架，涵盖任务构建、轨迹观测、评分和报告四个环节，并通过审计150条来自五个基准的失败轨迹，发现15.3%的FAIL判定是错误（10.7%评估器假阴性，4.7%任务损坏）。作者还提出了三层诊断分类法，指出验证/反馈和规划错误主导真实失败，而非执行/接地错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机使用代理（CUA）正在被部署用于浏览网页和操作桌面软件，但其基准评分仍常由脆弱的脚本化评估器产出，存在任务过时、轨迹缺少关键视觉证据、评估器拒绝有效替代方案、聚合报告掩盖失败原因等问题，导致分数不可靠。

Method: 作者首先将CUA评估中的问题组织为跨度任务构建、轨迹观测、评分和报告的可靠性框架；然后审计了来自五个网页、企业工作流和桌面控制基准的150条公共失败评分轨迹，揭示评估错误的比例；最后提出三层诊断分类法区分失败类型，并结合长期CUA基准推导出阶段特定的评估设计规则。

Result: 审计发现15.3%的FAIL判定是错误的，其中10.7%为评估器假阴性，4.7%为损坏的任务；对于真正的失败，验证/反馈和规划错误占主导，而非执行/接地错误；单一的成功率标量无法解释失败原因。

Conclusion: 现有CUA基准评估存在系统性可靠性缺陷，需要通过分阶段的评估设计规则来改进任务构建、轨迹观测、评分和报告环节，以提升CUA评估的可信度和诊断能力。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUA) are being deployed to browse the web and operate desktop software, yet their benchmark scores are still commonly produced by brittle scripted oracles. A score is the output of a pipeline in which tasks can be stale, trajectories can omit decisive visual evidence, evaluators can reject valid alternatives, and aggregate reports can hide the cause of failure. We organize these problems into a reliability framework spanning task construction, trajectory observation, scoring, and reporting. We then audit 150 public failure-scored trajectories from five web, enterprise-workflow, and desktop-control benchmarks, find that 15.3\% of FAIL verdicts are wrong: 10.7\% are evaluator false negatives and 4.7\% are broken tasks. For genuine failures, a three-tier diagnostic taxonomy shows that verification/feedback and planning failures dominate execution/grounding errors, while a single scalar success rate can not explain. We connect these findings to newer long-horizon CUA benchmarks and derive stage-specific design rules for CUA evaluation.

</details>


### [444] [HyperClaim: Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Hypergraph Reasoning for Video Misinformation Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28375)
*Xiangbo Wang,Jiasheng Zhang,Xingtong Yu,Luoqiang Lei,Delvin Ce Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HyperClaim，一种判别式时序超图框架，用于样本级视频虚假信息检测。通过构建稀疏异质超图建模查询词、证据文本与帧之间的高阶跨模态依赖，无需生成理由或外部工具，在FactGuard协议下于FakeSV、FakeTT、FakeVV三个数据集上分别取得83.7%、82.0%、87.3%的准确率，优于强判别式和推理式基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频虚假信息检测方法主要通过全局多模态融合或自由形式多模态推理，这两种范式都会低估由查询短语、上下文文本与短时帧片段之间耦合交互产生的局部真实性线索。这类交互本质上是高阶的，成对图模型无法捕捉多路跨模态依赖，而超图能提供合适的表示。

Method: HyperClaim构建稀疏异质超图，节点包括查询token、证据token和采样帧；采用置信度感知过滤与源预算形成紧凑的文本-帧和短时范围证据单元；执行自适应软关联推理并进行残差文本-视频校准；最后通过不一致性感知读出聚合文本、视觉和超边状态。

Result: 在FactGuard时间协议下，HyperClaim在FakeSV、FakeTT和FakeVV上分别达到83.7%、82.0%和87.3%的准确率，优于强判别式和推理为中心的基线。学习到的关联权重和注意力权重揭示了token级和帧级结构。

Conclusion: HyperClaim无需生成理由或外部工具调用，能保留全局融合容易压平的细粒度跨模态和时序结构，有效提升视频虚假信息检测性能。

Abstract: Video misinformation detection is often approached through global multimodal fusion or free-form multimodal reasoning. Both paradigms can under-represent localized authenticity cues that arise from coupled interactions among query phrases, contextual text, and short temporal spans of frames. Because such interactions are inherently higher-order, pairwise graph formulations are insufficient to capture multi-way cross-modal dependencies, whereas hypergraphs offer a suitable representation for these relations. We propose HyperClaim, a discriminative temporal hypergraph framework for sample-level authenticity classification. Using the title or benchmark-provided paired text as a claim-like query, HyperClaim constructs a sparse heterogeneous hypergraph over query tokens, evidence tokens, and sampled frames; applies confidence-aware filtering and source budgeting to form compact text-frame and short-range temporal evidence units; performs adaptive soft-incidence reasoning with residual text-video calibration; and aggregates textual, visual, and hyperedge states through a discrepancy-aware readout. Without relying on generated rationales or external tool calls, HyperClaim preserves fine-grained cross-modal and temporal structure that global fusion tends to flatten. Under the FactGuard temporal protocol, it achieves 83.7%, 82.0%, and 87.3% accuracy on FakeSV, FakeTT, and FakeVV, respectively, outperforming strong discriminative and reasoning-centric baselines. Learned incidence and attention weights further reveal token- and frame-level structure.

</details>


### [445] [When Specifications Conflict: A Symmetry-Based Framework for Measuring LLM Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28384)
*Tairan Wang,Liang Zhou,Zikang Zhan,Pingchuan Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个受控实验框架，用于研究LLM在相互冲突的规格说明之间的偏好选择。通过在可执行数学基准（550个冲突实例，11个函数族）上评估四种表示类型，发现模型偏好存在系统性模式：形式语言≈自然化形式语言>纯自然语言>输入-输出示例。该框架还扩展到布代数、代码生成和临床领域，验证了其跨任务通用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地需要整合可能不一致或冲突的多源信息，但缺乏可控、可归因的方法来分析模型如何解决竞争规格之间的冲突。

Method: 构建包含显式冲突的规格说明来控制冲突场景；采用基于对称性的实验设计以减少混淆因素；在550个冲突实例、11个函数族的可执行数学基准上比较四种表示类型（纯自然语言、形式语言、自然化形式语言、输入-输出示例）；并扩展到异质规格冲突（布代数、代码生成、临床领域）验证通用性。

Result: 模型在冲突规格下表现出系统性偏好而非随机行为，偏好排序一致为：形式语言≈自然化形式语言>纯自然语言>输入-输出示例；示例效应还依赖于模型能力和函数族。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种统一的、可归因的方法来衡量LLM如何解决竞争信息源之间的冲突，适用于多种任务和规格形式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly required to integrate multiple sources of information that may be inconsistent or conflicting. However, there is still a lack of controllable and attributable methods for analyzing how models resolve conflicts between competing specifications. We propose a controlled experimental framework for studying model preferences under conflicting specifications. By constructing specifications with explicit conflicts, the framework enables model choices between competing specifications to be directly observed and analyzed. A symmetry-based design further reduces confounding factors, allowing preferences across representation types to be compared systematically.
  We evaluate the framework on an executable mathematical benchmark with 550 conflict instances spanning 11 function families, comparing four representation types: pure natural language, formal language, naturalized formal language, and input--output examples. Results show systematic preference patterns rather than random behavior, with a consistent ordering: $ \text{Formal} \approx \text{Naturalized Formal} > \text{Pure Natural Language} > \text{Input--Output Examples} $. Example effects further depend on model capability and function family.
  We extend the framework to heterogeneous specification conflicts in Boolean algebra, code generation, and the clinical domain, demonstrating its applicability across diverse tasks and specification forms. The framework provides a unified approach for measuring how LLMs resolve conflicts between competing sources of information.

</details>


### [446] [QuantWAMs: Calibrating at the Right Granularity for World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28405)
*Jiacheng Zhou,Jinfan Lv,Ruixuan Li,Longtai Zhang,Yan Wang,Wenqiang Zhang,Lizhe Qi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QuantWAMs是一种针对世界动作模型(WAMs)的后训练量化(PTQ)框架，通过共享基元离群值校准、联合训练目标显著性分析和固定干预滚动审核三个策略，使量化决策与模型结构、部署分布和任务目标对齐。在W4A4精度设置下，仿真指标与FP16相差仅0.2-0.7个百分点，内存降至FP16的29%，块级加速1.4-1.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WAMs联合预测未来观测和动作，但迭代去噪和闭环执行使得高效部署代价高昂。现有PTQ方法不适用于WAMs，因为它们依赖开环目标、同质模型假设和与部署不符的校准分布，无法应对WAMs的闭环迭代特性。

Method: 提出三个策略：(1) 共享基元离群值校准——仅在坐标兼容的模块间池化激活证据；(2) 联合训练目标显著性——从视频-动作联合梯度计算经验Fisher分数，在校准稳定的层粒度上分配权重精度；(3) 固定干预滚动审核——利用可达闭环状态修订去噪步骤保护调度，不改变精度预算。

Result: 在Fast-WAM和LingBot-VA上，覆盖RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO及AgiBot G2真实机器人操作任务。W4A4主导设置下仿真均值与FP16相差0.2-0.7个百分点；真实机器人三项操作任务验证了部署可行性；目标视频和动作块的峰值权重与激活内存降至FP16的约29%，并提供1.4-1.6倍块级加速。

Conclusion: QuantWAMs通过将量化决策与校准上下文(模型结构、滚动分布、任务目标)对齐，有效克服了现有PTQ方法在WAMs上的不足，在不牺牲精度的前提下显著降低内存占用并提升推理速度，验证了真实机器人场景中的部署可行性。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, but their iterative denoising and closed-loop execution make efficient deployment costly. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods are poorly suited to WAMs because they rely on open-loop objectives, homogeneous model assumptions, and calibration distributions that do not reflect deployment. We present QuantWAMs, a PTQ framework that aligns quantization decisions with the calibration context defined by model structure, rollout distribution, and task objective. QuantWAMs introduces three strategies: shared-basis outlier calibration, which pools activation evidence only across coordinate-compatible modules; co-training-objective saliency, which computes empirical-Fisher scores from the joint video--action gradient and assigns weight precision at a calibration-stable layer granularity; and fixed-intervention rollout auditing, which revises denoising-step protection schedules using reachable closed-loop states without changing the precision budget. We evaluate QuantWAMs on Fast-WAM and LingBot-VA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot manipulation with an AgiBot G2. Under a W4A4-dominant setting, the reported simulation means differ from FP16 by 0.2--0.7 percentage points. Real-robot trials further establish deployment feasibility on three manipulation tasks. For the targeted video and action blocks, QuantWAMs reduces peak weight-and-activation memory to about 29\% of FP16 and provides 1.4--1.6$\times$ block-level speedups.

</details>


### [447] [When Derived Measurements Mislead: Quantifying and Mitigating LLM Over-Trust with Privileged-Modality Reliability Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28421)
*Zongheng Guo,Tao Chen,Tianli Li,Mingzhe Cui,Yang Jiao,Lei Xie,Yi Pan,Xiao Hu,Manuela Ferrario*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文定义了衍生特征过度信任（DFOT）问题——即LLM将实例相关的衍生测量值当作直接事实使用或超出其有效范围使用。以生理传感为例，设计了D1/D2两类测试和五个评估量（COTR、CIR、CRR、ESRM、UHR），在5万对PPG-ECG数据上验证了ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏基线，在187患者测试集上改善了四个修复和特异性指标1.82-6.69个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 衍生测量值（如传感器推导出的生理指标）逐渐被直接输入LLM管线作为事实使用，但其有效性是实例相关的（instance-dependent）。现有研究缺乏系统评估LLM是否恰当使用这些衍生测量值的框架，特别是当测量值与其真实状态冲突或超出有效范围时。

Method: 提出DFOT（衍生特征过度信任）评估框架：D1测试LLM接受被离线ECG证伪的PPG衍生心律，D2测试LLM在误导性严重病史下拒绝离线确认可靠的PPG心律。ECG仅用于监督训练和离线参考构建，从不暴露给LLM。定义五个评估量：COTR（冲突过度信任率）、CIR（情境诱导错误率）、CRR（正确修复率）、ESRM（证据特异修复裕度）、UHR（效用损害率）。框架不依赖特定可靠性生成器。

Result: 在5万对PPG-ECG记录上，以协议锁定的187患者测试集评估，ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏基线相比PPG-only推理在四个修复和特异性终点上提升1.82-6.69个百分点，所有配对置信区间排除零；UHR增加0.67个百分点（95% CI: -0.4到+1.7）。

Conclusion: DFOT提供了一个统一的评估目标，可用于比较和推动更强的衍生测量值缓解方法。该方法框架不依赖特定可靠性生成器，具有通用性。

Abstract: Derived measurements increasingly enter large language model (LLM) pipelines as direct facts despite their instance-dependent validity. We define derived-feature over-trust (DFOT) as the failure in which a downstream LLM assigns such a measurement the epistemic status of a direct fact or uses it outside its valid scope. Using physiological sensing as a case study, D1 tests acceptance of a PPG-derived rhythm contradicted by offline ECG, whereas D2 tests rejection of an offline-confirmed reliable PPG rhythm under misleading severe history. ECG supplies training supervision and offline reference construction but is never shown to the LLM. Five estimands quantify this chain: conflict over-trust rate (COTR) and context-induced error rate (CIR) characterize D1/D2; correct repair rate (CRR) measures frozen-error repair; evidence-specific repair margin (ESRM) contrasts matched and patient-disjoint shuffled evidence; and utility harm rate (UHR) measures unnecessary verification among HIGH-reliability cases used without verification at baseline. The framework does not depend on a particular reliability generator. We demonstrate it on 50,000 paired PPG-ECG records using ECG-to-PPG privileged distillation as an illustrative baseline and PPG-only inference. On a protocol-locked 187-patient test, the baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero; UHR increases by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7). DFOT provides a common evaluation target for stronger mitigation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/Zongheng-Guo/When-Derived-Measurements-Mislead.

</details>


### [448] [A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28432)
*Chenghan Wu,Zongmin Yu,Liu Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出UNICON（Unified In-Context Operator Networks），一个展现"数值智能"（numerical intelligence）的基础模型。它通过图结构示例作为上下文，推断系统间的预测关系，并跨学科（包括训练中未出现过的学科）接近专家模型性能，无需重新训练；与语言模型代理结合后甚至能超越未见学科中的最先进专家模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统对智能的理解聚焦于语言能力和基于文本上下文的推断，但科学和社会系统中的智能需要从数值上下文中获取和应用知识。现有的语言模型无法直接处理数值上下文中的知识获取与迁移问题，因此需要一种能在数值领域展现类似上下文学习能力的基础模型。

Method: UNICON通过使用来自同一系统的基于图的示例作为上下文，推断它们共享的预测关系，并将该关系应用于同一系统的查询。该模型采用统一的架构以适应跨学科任务，并可结合语言模型代理以增强性能。训练语料库的多样性被用来提升对未见学科的泛化能力。

Result: 在多个科学和社会系统中，UNICON即使面对训练中未出现的学科，也能在无需重新训练的情况下接近专家模型的性能。与语言模型代理结合后，UNICON在训练中未见过的学科上超越了最先进的专业模型。同时研究表明，训练语料库的多样性越高，对未见学科的泛化效果越好。

Conclusion: UNICON被确立为数值智能领域的基础模型，为更广泛的人工智能生态系统提供了构建模块。它证明了智能并不局限于语言领域，数值上下文中的知识获取与应用同样可以实现泛化的模型能力。

Abstract: Intelligence is commonly understood as the ability to acquire and apply knowledge, adapt to unfamiliar situations and solve new problems. Large language models exhibit this capacity by inferring task-relevant knowledge from textual context and applying it to new tasks. Yet intelligence need not be confined to language. For scientific and social systems, we need models that acquire and apply knowledge from numerical context-an ability we call numerical intelligence. Here we introduce UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON), a foundation model that exhibits numerical intelligence across disciplines. Using graph-based examples from a system as context, UNICON infers the predictive relation shared across them and applies it to queries from the same system. Across scientific and social systems, including those from disciplines absent from training, the same model approaches specialist performance without retraining. Combining UNICON with language-model agents yields further gains, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art specialists in a discipline unseen in training. We further show that training-corpus diversity improves generalization to unseen disciplines. Together, these results establish UNICON as a foundation model of numerical intelligence and position it as a building block for a broader ecosystem of artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [449] [LeanCSP: A Framework for Certifying Constraint Reformulation and Solving in Lean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28459)
*Pablo Manrique,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个在Lean定理证明器中建立的端到端验证框架，涵盖约束编程的两层验证：问题族层次的参数化语义保持证明（如等价性、可满足性等价、对称性破坏正确性），以及实例层次的求解器证书验证。实验表明，验证过的对称性破坏可将求解搜索开销降低最多2×10^7倍，且Lean内部证书检查在数分钟内完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束编程依赖求解器求解复杂组合问题，但结果的可信性需要两层保证：预处理改写是否保持语义，以及求解器是否给出正确答案。现有工作通常只覆盖其中一层或依赖信任外部工具，缺乏统一的端到端验证框架。

Method: 在Lean定理证明器中构建一个框架，第一层通过参数化证明支持问题族级别的等价性、可满足性等价及对称性破坏正确性验证；第二层通过翻译后端将实例导出为MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB等外部格式，并检查求解器返回的证书。两层结合形成不信任外部求解器的端到端工作流。

Result: 验证的对称性破坏将求解搜索开销降低最多2×10^7倍，每个问题族只需一次参数化证明即可跨所有实例规模复用；最大规模实例的Lean内证书检查仅需数分钟。

Conclusion: 该框架成功弥合了约束编程形式化验证中的两层鸿沟，既支持问题族级的通用属性证明，也支持实例级证书验证，实现了对外部求解器零信任的端到端可验证约束求解流程，且实际性能开销可控。

Abstract: Constraint programming is a core technology for solving complex combinatorial problems in scheduling, planning, configuration, and verification. Trusting its results therefore demands guarantees at two levels: that reformulations applied beforehand are semantics-preserving, and that solvers produce correct answers. In this work, we introduce a framework that addresses both verification levels in the Lean theorem prover: it can be used to prove formulation-level properties, such as equivalence, equisatisfiability, and the correctness of symmetry-breaking constraints, parametrically for entire problem families; and to check solver-produced certificates for individual instances via translation backends to external formats such as MiniZinc, SMT-LIB, and OPB. Combining both levels yields an end-to-end workflow that establishes the satisfiability or unsatisfiability of a constraint problem without trusting the external solver. Experimental results show that our framework's verified symmetry breaking also pays off in practice: a single parametric proof per problem family, reused across all instance sizes, reduces solver search effort by a factor of up to 2x10^7, while the entire in-Lean certification stays affordable, taking at most a few minutes for our largest instances.

</details>


### [450] [A report-grounded vision-language foundation model for colonoscopy from 280000 routine reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28466)
*Jia Yu,Yan Zhu,Yili He,Zilong Wang,Xinyang Jiang,Peiyao Fu,Ruijie Yang,Tianyi Chen,Siyuan Li,Zhihua Wang,Fei Wu,Quanlin Li,Xian Yang,Pinghong Zhou,Shuo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了EndoCLIP，一个基于125,756个病灶级图像-文本配对（从280,476份常规结肠镜检查报告中逐步恢复）训练的结肠镜视觉-语言基础模型，在病灶级图像-文本检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务中均优于通用及生物医学视觉-语言编码器，其线性探针在良恶性分类上接近12名内镜医师的专家水平，表明恢复发现与帧的对应关系可将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结肠镜检查中大量常规报告记录了丰富的专家描述（病灶外观、大小、位置），但这些报告汇总的是整个操作过程而非逐帧标注，导致临床发现与对应图像之间缺乏强关联，视觉-语言模型因而在结肠镜领域未被充分利用。

Method: 从280,476份常规结肠镜报告中逐步恢复出125,756个病灶级图像-文本配对，基于此训练EndoCLIP结肠镜视觉-语言基础模型，并在零样本和线性探针两种设置下进行评估测试。

Result: 在病灶级图像-文本检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务中，EndoCLIP均优于通用及生物医学视觉-语言编码器；在良恶性分类上，其线性探针性能接近12名内镜医师盲法研究中的专家水平。

Conclusion: 恢复发现与帧的对应关系可以将常规文书转化为可扩展的监督信号，使得临床目标能够以语言形式指定而无需为每个任务单独标注，为结肠镜临床AI应用提供了新范式。

Abstract: Vision-language models remain underused in colonoscopy despite the rich expert descriptions recorded in routine reports. These reports document lesion appearance, size and location but summarise entire procedures rather than caption individual frames, leaving clinical findings only weakly linked to the corresponding images. Here we develop EndoCLIP, a colonoscopy vision-language foundation model trained on 125,756 lesion-level image-text pairs progressively recovered from 280,476 routine colonoscopy records. Across lesion-level image-text retrieval, structured report generation and six multi-centre clinical classification tasks, EndoCLIP outperforms general-purpose and biomedical vision-language encoders in both zero-shot and linear-probe settings. On benign-versus-malignant classification, its linear probe approaches the performance of expert readers in a blinded study involving 12 endoscopists. These results suggest that recovering finding-to-frame correspondence can transform routine documentation into scalable supervision, enabling clinical targets to be specified in language rather than separately annotated for each task.

</details>


### [451] [Towards Autonomous Aircraft Surveillance from Nanosatellites through On-Board Inference and Generative Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28470)
*Antonio Delgado-Rosa,David Muñoz-Valero,Enrique Adrian Villarrubia-Martin,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合星上推理与生成式数据增强的工作流，解决纳卫星低轨航空监视中下行带宽受限与小样本类不平衡两个瓶颈。在6U CubeSat上部署低功耗边缘张量加速器执行推理，并用低秩微调的扩散模型生成合成少数类样本（自动伪标注），与经典增强样本合并构成均衡数据集，使全局mAP从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1从0.683提升至0.811，量化检测器可在轨运行25-30帧/秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纳卫星低轨航空监视面临两个相互关联的瓶颈：一是下行链路预算有限，但传统方案仍将TB级原始图像传输至地面处理，延误决策；二是开放航空卫星数据集稀缺且类别严重失衡，导致标准检测器难以学习稀有飞机类别的鲁棒表征。二者共同制约了实时、自主的星上航空监视能力。

Method: 提出一个联合工作流：(1) 在6U CubeSat上搭载低功耗边缘张量加速器执行星上推理，避免回传原始数据；(2) 通过低秩适配（LoRA）微调的扩散模型生成合成少数类航空影像；(3) 由中间检测器对合成影像自动伪标注；(4) 将伪标注的生成样本与经典数据增强样本合并，构成类别均衡的训练数据集。整个流程将卫星从被动数据采集器（传统弯曲管道架构）转变为决策支持工具。

Result: 均衡数据集使全局平均精度（mAP）从77.9%提升至82.2%；少数类F1分数从0.683提升至0.811。量化后的检测器适配片上内存，在轨推理速度达到25-30帧/秒，验证了计算可行性与实时监视能力。

Conclusion: 计算实验支持所提工作流可作为纳卫星实时自主航空监视的决策支持工具，能同时解决下行带宽瓶颈与类别不平衡问题，为未来星上自主感知提供了一种不同于传统被动回传架构的有效方案。

Abstract: Airborne surveillance from low Earth orbit is hindered by two interconnected bottlenecks: nanosatellites have a limited downlink budget, yet the conventional approach still transmits terabytes of raw imagery to the ground for processing, and open satellite datasets for aircraft are scarce and severely class-imbalanced. These limitations either delay timely decision-making or prevent standard detectors from learning robust representations of rare aircraft classes. In this paper, a workflow that combines on-board inference with generative data augmentation is proposed to address both limitations jointly. Inference is executed on a 6U CubeSat equipped with a low-power edge tensor accelerator, while a diffusion model fine-tuned through low-rank adaptation generates synthetic minority-class imagery. This synthetic output is automatically annotated, pseudo-labelled, by an intermediate detector and merged with classically augmented samples. The results show that the balanced dataset increases global mean average precision from 77.9% to 82.2%, with the minority class rising from F1=0.683 to F1=0.811, and that the quantised detector fits the on-chip memory and projects 25-30 frames per second on orbit. This approach contrasts with the conventional bent-pipe architecture, in which the satellite acts as a passive data collector. Therefore, the computational tests support the proposed workflow as a decision-support tool for real-time, autonomous airborne surveillance from nanosatellites.

</details>


### [452] [A Fuzzy Rule-based Neuro-Symbolic Approach for Pipe Severity Prediction in Sewer Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28481)
*Ngoc Thai Le,Thanh Ma,Umberto Straccia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化的模糊规则神经符号框架，将神经网络感知（Swin Transformer预测14个多标签缺陷CODE等级）与符号推理（J48决策树转化为19条IF-THEN规则，通过模糊逻辑加权）解耦，用于自动化污水管道严重程度评估。在3,244张图像的五个高度不平衡严重类别上，相比纯图像分类方法，准确率、平衡准确率、宏F1和MCC分别提升17.9%、12.2%、23.0%和17.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化污水管道严重程度评估依赖直接图像分类，形成一个"黑箱"——视觉缺陷与最终严重等级之间的关联是隐性的，缺乏可解释性和可追溯性。

Method: 框架分为两个解耦模块：(1) 感知模块：使用Swin Transformer直接从图像预测14个多标签检查CODE等级；(2) 推理模块：在真实CODE和严重程度标签上训练J48决策树，将其路径转换为19条固定IF-THEN规则，通过模糊逻辑（t-norm激活加权规则置信度，s-norm组合产生类别证据）进行推理。评估了Product、Łukasiewicz和Hamacher算子对。真实标签由五个独立大语言模型分析原始检查员注释并共识生成。

Result: 在3,244张图像的五类高度不平衡严重数据上，相对纯图像分类，准确率提升17.9%，平衡准确率提升12.2%，宏F1提升23.0%，MCC提升17.3%。框架在保持竞争力类别平衡性能的同时，实现了从预测CODE等级到规则支持和严重程度证据的可追溯推理。

Conclusion: 该神经符号框架成功弥合了神经感知与符号推理之间的鸿沟，提供了竞争性的类别平衡性能与可解释的推理路径，使管道缺陷到严重程度评分的映射清晰可追踪。

Abstract: Standard automated sewer pipe severity assessment relies on direct image classification, creating a "black box" where the link between visual defects and final severity scores remains implicit. This study introduces a modular, fuzzy rule-based neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by decoupling neural perception from symbolic reasoning. The perception module utilizes a Swin Transformer to predict 14 multilabel inspection CODE degrees directly from images. For reasoning, a DT, specifically Weka's J48, algorithm is trained on ground-truth CODEs and severity labels, and its paths are converted into 19 fixed IF--THEN rules. Inference operates via fuzzy logic: t-norm activations from CODE conditions are weighted by rule confidence and combined with corresponding s-norms to produce interpretable class evidence. We assessed Product, Łukasiewicz, and Hamacher operator pairs using a dataset of 3,244 images spanning five highly imbalanced severity classes. Ground-truth labels were robustly generated via consensus from five independent large language models analyzing original inspector notes. Our results show an improvement of accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1 and MCC by 17.9%, 12.2%, 23.0%, and 17.3%, respectively, over image-only based classification.
  Overall, the framework combines competitive class-balanced performance with traceable reasoning from predicted CODE degrees to rule supports and severity evidence.

</details>


### [453] [SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28488)
*Yunhao Liang,Xianqi Cao,Pujun Zhang,Yuan Qu,Yongzhi Qi,Ningxuan Kang,Max Z. J. Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE框架，将供应链AI从孤立的决策模块转向统一的端到端运营规划，通过将供应链实体表示为token、共享操作表示和耦合策略来协同规划品类选择、货源分配、补货频率和配送路径，并在叮咚买菜和京东的真实数据上验证其优于分阶段优化的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代供应链中，品类选择、货源分配、补货频率和配送路由等决策在运营上紧密耦合（品类影响需求和负载、货源与补货频率改变配送请求、路由成本决定前期决策价值），但实际中这些决策往往由不同部门通过独立系统分别优化，导致缺货、库存风险和可避免的运输成本。因此需要超越孤立决策模块、走向统一运营规划的方案。

Method: 提出SCOPE（Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination）复合策略模型：将供应链实体（如商品、门店、仓库等）表示为token，通过共享的操作表示进行上下文关联，并将每种token类型映射到对应的决策接口。每个决策建立在前面决策形成的部分计划之上，完整计划通过共享的系统级效用函数进行评估。在都市生鲜零售补货场景中实例化该框架，该场景中服务频率、品类、产能压力和路网路由之间存在强交互。

Result: 在叮咚买菜和京东两个大规模供应链的真实运营数据上进行评估，这两个供应链处于不同的补货层级。在两种场景下，SCOPE均一致地优于单独优化每个决策阶段的方法，以及供应链运营中常用的实践导向基线。

Conclusion: 学习并协调跨部门的运营耦合能够带来更有效的端到端供应链决策，表明供应链AI可以从孤立模块向统一的端到端运营规划演进。

Abstract: Can supply-chain AI move beyond isolated decision modules toward unified operational planning? A complete replenishment plan specifies which products each location carries, which upstream facility supplies it, how often it is replenished, and how deliveries are routed. These decisions are operationally coupled: the selected assortment changes the demand and load passed to later stages; source assignment and replenishment frequency reshape the delivery requests; and route feasibility and cost, in turn, determine the system value of the earlier choices. Yet in modern supply chains, these decisions are often handled by separate departments and optimized through separate systems, which can lead to stockouts, inventory exposure, and avoidable transportation. We propose SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination, a composite policy model that represents supply-chain entities as tokens, contextualizes them through a shared operational representation, and maps each token type to the corresponding decision interface. Each decision builds on the partial plan formed by earlier decisions while the completed plan is evaluated using a shared system-level utility. We instantiate this framework in urban fresh-retail replenishment, where service frequency, assortment, capacity pressure, and road-network routing interact strongly, and evaluate it on real operational data from Dingdong and JD.com, two large-scale supply chains operating at different replenishment echelons. Across both settings, SCOPE consistently outperforms methods that optimize each decision stage separately, as well as practice-oriented baselines commonly used in supply-chain operations. These results show that learning and coordinating cross-department operational couplings lead to more effective end-to-end supply-chain decisions.

</details>


### [454] [InfoOps Bench: A live information operations safety benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28503)
*Dorian Quelle,Lisa-Maria Neudert,Jonathan Bright,John Gallacher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个动态、持续更新的AI基准测试（InfoOpsBench），用于衡量前沿语言模型被国家支持的信息操作所利用的完整性风险。基于对2,100多个来自俄罗斯、中国和伊朗的国家支持信息操作的实时监控数据，测试了8家供应商的17个模型，发现大多数模型可以被利用进行信息操作，完整性得分从8.8%到94.5%不等，且与模型规模无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型被广泛部署，其可能被恶意行为者（特别是国家支持的信息操作）利用来进行虚假信息传播。现有的静态基准测试容易饱和，且缺乏针对信息操作这一特定安全威胁的系统性评估，因此需要构建一个动态、持续更新的基准来评估模型的完整性（integrity）。

Method: 基于实时监控管道收集的2,100多个来自俄罗斯、中国和伊朗国家支持的信息操作内容，构建动态AI基准测试。测试8家提供商的17个模型，采用四种不同的提示框架（prompt framings），通过计算拒绝请求的百分比（完整性得分）来评估模型抵抗信息操作的能力，并分析模型规模、提示框架及请求内容对结果的影响。

Result: 大多数模型可以被利用进行信息操作。完整性得分范围从8.8%到94.5%，差异达85.7个百分点，且该差异无法由模型规模解释。模型选择会影响生成内容的质量：部分模型会编造细节并产生比源材料更有害的输出，而其他模型即使在配合时也会缓和说法。事实核查率从2.9%到72.9%不等。中国开发的模型在面对基于事实的对华批评性声明时合规率大幅下降48-70个百分点（GLM 5.2除外）。

Conclusion: 前沿语言模型面临被国家支持信息操作利用的普遍性风险，完整性表现与模型规模无关。模型对信息操作的完整性至少部分与对良性内容的拒答倾向相关，反映出模型可用性与安全性之间的权衡。中国开发模型在对华批评性内容上的合规率骤降暗示特定地域政治因素影响模型行为。该动态基准通过持续更新抵抗饱和问题，为AI安全和治理提供了新的评估工具。

Abstract: In this paper we present an active, constantly updated AI benchmark which measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for state-backed information operations. We draw on over 2,100 information operations from a live monitoring pipeline which tracks Russian, Chinese and Iranian state-backed information assets. Alongside this paper, we release a companion website that tracks the most prominent claims spread by state-backed media outlets, updated weekly, available from: pattrn.ai/research/infoopsbench. The dynamic nature of the benchmark makes it resistant to saturation.
  In the benchmark, we test 17 models from 8 providers across four prompt framings. We find that most models can be co-opted for information operations. Integrity scores, defined as the percentage of refused requests, range from 8.8% to 94.5%, an 85.7-percentage-point spread not explained by model size. Model choice also changes the character of the resulting operation. Some models fabricate details and produce output more harmful than the source material, others defuse claims even while complying, and fact-checking rates vary from 2.9% to 72.9%.
  Integrity against information operations is at least partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, illustrating the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. With one exception (Z.ai's GLM 5.2), the Chinese-developed models sharply cut compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims, dropping 48-70 percentage points relative to matched benign claims.

</details>


### [455] [Selective Credibility-Limited Belief Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28523)
*Theofanis Aravanis,Costas D. Koutras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性可信度受限信念更新（selective credibility-limited belief update）框架，将复合认知输入相对于每个源世界转化为更弱的代理后执行可信度受限的转移，提供了语义和公理化刻画，并识别了两个良态子类，统一了Katsuno-Mendelzon更新与可信度受限信念更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可信度受限信念更新方法将认知输入视为不可分割的整体，无法表达仅部分复合认知输入可实现的情形。这限制了其在复杂信念变化场景中的表达能力。

Method: 引入选择性可信度受限信念更新算子，其核心思想是在每个源世界处先将认知输入转化为更弱的代理（proxy），再执行可信度受限的转移；提供了语义与公理化双重刻画，并识别了两个子类：一致性保持更新算子（要求原输入一致时变换后的输入可靠）和极大一致性保持更新算子（额外要求代理在可靠结果中信息量最大）。

Result: 实现了对更新算子的语义与公理化刻画；识别了两个良态子类（一致性保持与极大一致性保持）；证明了可信度受限信念更新是该框架的特例，而去除可信度限制且变换函数取恒等时恢复Katsuno-Mendelzon信念更新。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了既有信念更新方法，具有更强的表达力，支持源依赖的选择性接受，为信念更新研究提供了更具一般性的理论基础。

Abstract: Belief update concerns changes in an agent's beliefs induced by changes in the underlying world. Standard Katsuno-Mendelzon update assumes that an epistemic input can be incorporated from every initially possible world, whereas credibility-limited belief update restricts, for each source world, the successor worlds regarded as credible or reachable. Nevertheless, existing credibility-limited approaches treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole, and therefore cannot represent cases in which only part of a compound epistemic input can be realized. We introduce selective credibility-limited belief update, in which the epistemic input is transformed, relative to each source world, into a weaker proxy before the credibility-limited transition is performed. We provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of update operators. We then identify two well-behaved sub-classes; namely, consistency-preserving update operators, which require every transformed epistemic input to be credible from its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, and maximal consistency-preserving update operators, which additionally require the selected proxy to be maximally informative among the credible consequences of the original epistemic input. Finally, we establish the generality of the proposed framework by showing that credibility-limited belief update is recovered as a special case, while Katsuno--Mendelzon belief update emerges when credibility restrictions are removed and the transformation functions are taken to be identities. These results demonstrate that the framework provides a unified and strictly more expressive account of belief update, encompassing established approaches while supporting source-dependent selective acceptance.

</details>


### [456] [MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28527)
*Mao-xun Huang,Jerry Wang,Yi-Cheng Lai,Zhengxin Zhang,Claire Cardie,Hen-Hsen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MANTA是一个多智能体网络拓扑自适应框架，允许通信结构在推理时自我演化，通过在五个基准上超越最强基线5.8个百分点（平均得分74.0），证明了推理时自改进可以扩展到协作架构本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的多智能体系统虽然通过任务分解、智能体专业化、信息交换和中间验证提升了复杂问题求解能力，但通常将通信拓扑视为固定设计选择或离线优化目标，缺乏在推理阶段动态调整通信结构的能力。

Method: MANTA框架包含两个阶段：(1)执行前，从先前的结构经验中初始化一个任务条件化的拓扑；(2)部署期间，监控协作轨迹并在当前组织不足时施加有界结构更新。这些更新可修改智能体角色、通信链路、执行顺序、信息可见性和验证路径，同时保持任务接口和智能体预算不变。

Result: 在涵盖信息检索、工具使用、规划、工作流执行和数学推理的五个基准上，MANTA平均得分74.0，超越最强基线5.8个百分点，并在PlanCraft上取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 推理时自改进可以扩展到协作架构本身，即通信拓扑的自我演化能够显著提升多智能体系统的性能，为多智能体协作架构的适应性设计提供了新方向。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through task decomposition, agent specialization, information exchange, and intermediate validation. However, existing systems typically treat communication topology as a fixed design choice or an offline optimization target. We introduce MANTA, a framework for Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation that enables communication structures to self-evolve at inference time. Before execution, MANTA initializes a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience. During deployment, it monitors collaboration traces and applies bounded structural updates when the current organization becomes insufficient. These updates can modify agent roles, communication links, execution order, information visibility, and validation pathways while preserving the task interface and agent budget. We evaluate MANTA against representative single-agent and multi-agent baselines on five benchmarks spanning information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning. MANTA achieves the highest average score of 74.0, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.8 percentage points and obtaining the best result on PlanCraft. These results show that inference-time self-improvement can extend to the architecture of collaboration itself.

</details>


### [457] [Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28573)
*Woongkyu Lee,Jungwook Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）在资源受限的本地计算机使用智能体（CUA）上的效果，涵盖上下文、时间、结构和并行四个维度。在OSWorld基准上对多个本地模型进行评估后发现，额外计算往往收益递减且改变失败模式：上下文扩展虽能改善轨迹稳定性和准确率但收益饱和；时间扩展无法显著提升任务成功率；结构分解和并行扩展也各有局限。研究建议本地CUA需要选择性计算分配、失败感知控制机制以及针对本地模型能力定制的智能体框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署本地计算机使用智能体对隐私保护、成本效率和实际可用性日益重要，但在严格硬件约束下提升性能仍是挑战。虽然已有研究表明推理时扩展可以改善前沿CUA的性能，但其对资源受限的本地模型是否有效尚不明确，因此需要系统性研究来填补这一空白。

Method: 在OSWorld基准上，对Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B和OpenCUA-7B四个本地模型进行系统性的推理时扩展实证研究，从四个维度展开：上下文扩展（contextual scaling）、时间扩展（temporal scaling）、结构分解（structural scaling）和并行扩展（parallel scaling）。

Result: 研究发现：1）额外计算往往带来收益递减并改变失败模式；2）上下文扩展提供历史依据可改善轨迹稳定性和任务准确率，但随着token成本增加收益饱和，失败从重复/停滞轨迹转向过早的假成功；3）时间扩展减少最大步数停滞但无法实质性提升任务成功率，更长的推理视野往往延长错误轨迹而非纠正它们；4）结构分解在本地两阶段智能体中引入规划和格式开销；5）并行扩展只能部分缓解这些失败且计算成本高昂。

Conclusion: 高效的本地CUA需要选择性计算分配策略、失败感知的控制机制，以及围绕本地模型的能力与局限设计的智能体框架，而非简单地缩放推理计算量。

Abstract: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents (CUAs) locally is increasingly important for privacy, cost efficiency, and practical usability, yet improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. While recent studies show that inference-time scaling can improve frontier computer-use agents through additional computation during execution, its effectiveness for resource-constrained local models remains poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local CUAs across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark. Our results show that additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling provides historical grounding that improves trajectory stability and task accuracy, but its gains saturate as token cost increases and failures shift from repetitive or stalled trajectories toward premature false successes. Temporal scaling similarly reduces max-step stalls, yet does not substantially improve task success, indicating that longer horizons often extend erroneous trajectories rather than correct them. We further find that structural decomposition can introduce planning and formatting overhead in local two-stage agents, while parallel scaling partially mitigates these failures at a substantial computational cost. Overall, our findings suggest that efficient local CUAs require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.

</details>


### [458] [DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28580)
*Jiacheng Tao,Qingyun Sun,Haonan Yuan,Ziwei Zhang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DualG-MRAG，一个用于多模态检索增强生成（MM-RAG）的双层框架，通过解耦的Macro推理图和Micro匹配图分别处理全局结构推理与细粒度证据匹配，以GNN检索器实现查询驱动的动态消息传递，并通过动态规划解码提取显式推理路径，在证据召回率和复杂问答准确率上均超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态RAG方法在复杂多跳推理任务中表现不佳。已有方法主要依赖独立的实例级匹配，无法捕获跨模态、跨文档间的显式关系；尽管图增强方法引入了结构建模，但在多模态场景下面临根本性困境：引入细粒度视觉特征会导致图快速膨胀和检索噪声增加，而采用粗粒度表示又会丢失关键局部证据。这一矛盾亟需一种能够同时兼顾结构推理和细粒度证据匹配的框架。

Method: DualG-MRAG采用双层解耦架构：(1) 构建Macro Graph用于全局拓扑路由，Micro Graph用于精确局部验证，通过隔离全局结构推理与细粒度证据匹配来抑制检索噪声；(2) 将检索形式化为查询驱动的消息传递过程，使用GNN检索器实现跨异构证据源的动态相关性传播；(3) 引入动态规划解码机制，直接从GNN前向传播中提取显式推理路径，替代标准输入的孤立文档块，为生成模型提供连贯的结构引导。

Result: 大量实验表明，DualG-MRAG在证据召回率和复杂问答准确率方面均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: DualG-MRAG通过解耦宏推理与微匹配的双层图架构，有效解决了多模态RAG中结构建模与细粒度证据保留之间的两难困境，为复杂多跳多模态问答提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. Furthermore, to provide the generative model with coherent structural guidance, we introduce a dynamic programming decoding mechanism that extracts explicit reasoning paths directly from the GNN's forward pass, replacing the standard input of isolated document chunks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [459] [ESBT: A Scalable and Deterministic Sequence CRDT for Distributed Collaborative Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28101)
*Moulay Driss Mechaoui,Abdessamad Imine*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出扩展Stern-Brocot树（ESBT），一种用于分布式协作文本编辑的序列CRDT标识分配方案，通过提供密集、确定性和紧凑的标识空间，在保持强最终一致性的同时限制标识增长和内存消耗，相比Logoot和LSEQ等基线方法显著提升了响应速度并减少了50-92%的标识内存开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的序列CRDT虽能保证强最终一致性（SEC），但在长时间高并发编辑会话中存在标识符无限增长和内存消耗不断攀升的问题，严重制约了可扩展性和性能，亟需一种兼具密集性、确定性和紧凑性的标识分配方案。

Method: 提出扩展Stern-Brocot树（ESBT）标识分配方案，基于数学上的Stern-Brocot树构造密集且有界的标识空间，既保证操作的确定性排序和强最终一致性，又限制标识符的无限增长。实验在50个协作站点上生成高达100,000个并发操作的工作负载进行验证。

Result: 在纯插入工作负载下响应速度提升28-88%，混合插入/删除工作负载下提升59-74%；标识内存消耗在开头和随机插入模式下较最优基线（Logoot和LSEQ）减少50-75%；对抗性中间插入工作负载（10,000个操作）下响应速度提升86.53%，标识大小减少92.81%。

Conclusion: ESBT有效解决了现有序列CRDT的扩展性瓶颈，为大规协作编辑系统提供了高效且可扩展的基础支撑，在响应性和内存效率两方面均显著优于主流基线方法。

Abstract: Modern collaborative editing systems require efficient mechanisms for managing concurrent updates across distributed replicas. Sequence Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) have become the de facto standard for supporting decentralized collaboration; they enable decentralized replicas to apply operations in arbitrary order while converging to a common state. Although existing sequence CRDTs guarantee Strong Eventual Consistency (SEC), they often suffer from uncontrolled identifier growth and increasing memory consumption during long-running, highly concurrent editing sessions, which severely limits their scalability and performance. This paper presents the Extended Stern-Brocot Tree (ESBT), a mathematically grounded identifier allocation scheme for distributed collaborative text editing, providing a dense, deterministic, and compact identifier space. The proposed allocation strategy bounds identifier growth while preserving deterministic ordering and Strong Eventual Consistency. Experimental evaluation using workloads of up to 100,000 concurrent operations generated across 50 collaborating sites shows that ESBT improves responsiveness by 28 to 88% under pure insertions and 59 to 74% under mixed insertion/deletion workloads, while reducing identifier memory consumption by 50 to 75% in beginning and random insertion patterns compared with the best-performing baseline sequence CRDTs (Logoot and LSEQ). Under the adversarial middle-insertion workload (10,000 operations), ESBT further improves responsiveness by 86.53% and reduces identifier size by 92.81%. These results demonstrate that ESBT effectively addresses the principal scalability limitations of existing sequence CRDTs and provides an efficient and scalable foundation for large-scale collaborative editing systems.

</details>


### [460] [SmartGen: Seamless Disaggregated LLM Inference with Selective KV Cache Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28150)
*Xuchuan Luo,Jiacheng Shen,Xin Wang,Yangfan Zhou*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SmartGen是一个KV缓存传输引擎，通过选择性传输关键KV缓存条目而非全量传输，解决LLM推理中prefill和decoding阶段分离部署时云实例间网络带宽瓶颈问题，将time-to-second-token降低最多4.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM服务系统广泛采用将prefill和decoding阶段分离到不同节点的架构，但在租用云实例的自托管LLM部署场景中，节点间传输海量KV缓存会轻易占满有限的网络带宽，成为系统瓶颈。

Method: SmartGen设计了三类数据传输路径：(1)基于profile的主动传输路径，在prefill阶段识别并推送关键KV条目到decoding节点；(2)并行按需传输路径，在decoding阶段同时获取远程和本地KV条目；(3)投机性传输路径，最终将所有KV缓存完整传送至decoding节点。

Result: 与典型的全量KV缓存传输方法相比，SmartGen将time-to-second-token最多减少4.3倍，同时保持相当的后续解码性能和准确率。

Conclusion: 通过选择性KV传输策略，SmartGen有效缓解了分离式LLM推理中的网络瓶颈，实现了在有限带宽环境下高性能的disaggregated LLM推理。

Abstract: Disaggregating the prefill and decoding stages of large language model (LLM) inference into two separate sets of nodes is widely adopted in today's LLM serving systems. However, such an architecture poses significant challenges for self-hosted LLM deployments on rented cloud instances, since transferring enormous key-value (KV) caches between disaggregated nodes can easily saturate the limited inter-node network bandwidth. In this paper, we propose to mitigate the network bottleneck by selectively transferring essential KV cache entries across the two stages. There are two challenges to achieve selective KV cache transfer, i.e., accurate KV selection during the prefill stage, and efficient KV fetching during the decoding stage. To address these challenges, we design SmartGen, a KV cache transfer engine that allows seamless disaggregated LLM inference with three data transfer paths. Specifically, we leverage 1) a profile-based proactive transfer path to identify and push essential KV cache entries to the decoding node during the prefill stage, 2) a parallel on-demand transfer path to simultaneously fetch remote and local KV cache entries during the decoding stage, and 3) a speculative transfer path to finally deliver all KV caches to the decoding node. Experimental results show that SmartGen reduces time-to-second-token by up to 4.3x compared with the typical full KV cache transfer approach while offering comparable subsequent decoding performance and accuracy.

</details>


### [461] [A Cloud Continuum Research Infrastructure for Distributed CPS Experimentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28193)
*Fabio Orazio Mirto,Giuseppe Tricomi,Luca D'Agati,Andrea Sabbioni,Stefano Silvestri,Francesco Longo,Giovanni Merlino,Armir Bujari,Paolo Bellavista,Antonio Puliafito*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于SLICES Cloud Continuum Blueprint的两层参考架构，用于Cloud Continuum实验，分离研究基础设施层与应用层，并通过可再生能源社区管理和AirWatch两个用例、40次系统运行验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Cloud Continuum应用需要能够组合异构Edge、Fog、Cloud和HPC资源的实验环境，同时保持可复现性、可观测性和对分布式部署的控制。现有方案多为单一领域原型，缺乏支持多种连续体应用的可编程基础设施平台。

Method: 提出两层参考架构：(1) 研究基础设施层负责暴露和管理分布式资源；(2) 应用层按Edge-Fog-Cloud模式组织Cyber-Physical工作流，将放置、时序和数据溯源作为一等公民的实验关注点。Edge负责低延迟感知和安全动作，Fog执行近源协调、中介和流处理，Cloud进行全局分析、优化和可视化。

Result: 通过可再生能源社区管理和AirWatch两个代表性用例进行验证，每个工作负载在地理分布式基础设施上进行了40次系统性运行，比较了虚拟化与物理边缘部署。

Conclusion: 该架构支持多种连续体应用而非单一领域原型，使研究者能够在同一可编程基础设施基底上部署、定制和比较替代性控制与监控策略。

Abstract: Cloud Continuum applications require experimental environments capable of combining heterogeneous Edge, Fog, Cloud, and high-performance computing resources while preserving reproducibility, observability, and control over distributed deployments. This paper presents a two-level reference architecture for Cloud Continuum experimentation built on top of the SLICES Cloud Continuum Blueprint. The proposed approach separates the research-infrastructure layer, which exposes and manages distributed resources, from the application layer, where Cyber-Physical workflows are organized according to an Edge-Fog-Cloud pattern in which placement, timing, and data provenance are treated as first-class experimental concerns.
  The architecture is designed to support multiple continuum applications rather than a single domain-specific prototype. At the Edge, applications interact with physical devices and perform low-latency sensing or safety actions; at the Fog, they execute near-source coordination, mediation, and stream-processing logic; at the Cloud, they consolidate global knowledge through analytics, optimization, and visualization. This partitioning enables researchers to deploy, customize, and compare alternative control and monitoring strategies over the same programmable infrastructure substrate.
  The approach is validated through two representative use cases: Renewable Energy Community management, where distributed Digital Twin coordination and time-window-based energy control are requested, and AirWatch, a monitoring pipeline focused on anomaly detection, low-latency alerting, and cloud-side aggregation. Both workloads are evaluated through a systematic campaign of 40 runs comparing virtualized and physical edge deployments over a geographically distributed infrastructure.

</details>


### [462] [Queue-Theoretic Admission Control for Multi-Tenant GPU Clusters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28223)
*Sohan Kunkerkar*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 该论文首次将GPU集群调度等待时间问题形式化为多类别、多资源排队网络，证明了挂起队列的结构分解定理（可报价负载与不可行负载），并通过M/G/k模型与向量装箱归约建立了等待时间的复杂度与理论边界，在Kueue系统上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU集群算子无法预测挂起工作负载的等待时长，现有系统依赖贪婪启发式方法却缺少形式化的等待时间保证，这导致用户在资源紧张时难以获得可预期的调度延迟承诺。

Method: 将GPU集群准入问题形式化为多类别、多资源排队网络，证明等待队列的结构性分解；对可报价负载用M/G/k系统建模，其中有效服务器数k由向量装箱归约确定；基于随机占优假设建立O(1/(1-rho))的等待时间缩放边界；通过从向量装箱的归约证明最优准入排序是NP难的；最后在Kueue（Kubernetes标准队列系统）上用CPU、内存和GPU（Dynamic Resource Allocation）资源进行验证。

Result: 向量k_eff正确识别了瓶颈资源维度；Little定律精确成立；Erlang-C近似在保守方向上持续高估观测等待时间。

Conclusion: 该工作为GPU集群准入提供了首个形式化的等待时间保证框架，明确了可报价与不可行工作负载的边界，并指出最优调度排序的NP-hard本质，同时其保守的Erlang-C近似为实际系统提供了安全的上界估计。

Abstract: GPU cluster operators cannot predict how long pending workloads will wait for admission. Existing systems use greedy heuristics with no formal wait time guarantees. We formalize GPU cluster admission as a multi-class, multi-resource queueing network and prove a structural decomposition: the pending queue partitions into quotable workloads (bounded wait time under stability) and unfeasible workloads (no finite bound without reconfiguration). For quotable workloads, we model each cluster queue as an M/G/k system where the effective server count k is determined by a vector packing reduction; under an explicit stochastic domination assumption, we establish O(1/(1-rho)) wait time scaling. We prove that optimal admission ordering is NP-hard under multi-dimensional resource demands via reduction from vector bin packing. We validate on Kueue, the standard Kubernetes workload queuing system, using CPU, memory, and GPU (via Dynamic Resource Allocation) resources. The vector k_eff correctly identifies bottleneck resource dimensions, Little's Law holds exactly, and the Erlang-C approximation consistently overestimates observed wait times in the conservative direction.

</details>


### [463] [FAIR-Compute: A Roadmap for Fair and Efficient Allocation of Federated Digital Research Infrastructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28290)
*Konstantinos,E. Zachariadis,Ahmed Sayed,Dimitris Fotakis,Angeliki Mathioudaki,Wan Shuen Siaw*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FAIR-Compute项目研究联邦式数字研究基础设施（DRI）中稀缺计算资源的分配问题，将调度器设置视为政策而非纯技术问题。通过景观综述、机制设计模型和仿真研究三方面证据，发现三个核心结论：分配记录衡量占用而非利用、简单透明调度启发式接近离线最优基准、联邦化虽有价值但在无管理时像无协调路由一样会带来负载集中甚至Braess悖论效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能计算、高通量计算和数据存储需求不断增长，稀缺计算资源的分配方式（而非仅仅资源总量）已成为英国研究生产力的决定性因素。研究者认为，一旦共享系统必须决定谁运行、何时运行以及基于什么证据，调度设置就不再是纯技术问题，而变成了政策问题。

Method: 项目结合三条证据链：（1）对英国及国际分配实践的景观综述（涵盖EuroHPC、WLCG、ACCESS、JASMIN和DiRAC），辅以利益相关者调查；（2）基于战略性和不确定性用户报告的机制设计分配模型；（3）基于公开Fresco/Anvil工作负载轨迹的仿真研究和受控合成压力测试。

Result: 三条证据链中反复出现三个结果：（1）分配记录衡量的是占用（预留资源）而非利用（完成的实际有用工作），系统无法回答UKRI和DSIT最关心的问题——资源是否产生生产性价值；（2）简单透明的调度启发式在调优后接近离线全信息基准的性能，近期机会在于调优和监测现有调度器而非替换；（3）联邦化确实有价值，但在无人管理时表现为无协调路由：能最小化平均延迟，却悄悄地将负载（乃至潜在损害）集中在接收系统上，类似于道路交通经济学中的Braess悖论。

Conclusion: 研究将计算资源分配定位为算法博弈论、交通经济学与HPC调度的交叉问题，强调调度器设置是政策决策。主要启示是：应改进测量指标以反映实际生产力，通过调优而非替换现有调度器获得近期收益，并需要主动管理联邦化以避免Braess悖论式的整体性能恶化。

Abstract: As demand for high-performance computing (HPC), high-throughput computing and data storage grows, the way scarce compute is allocated -- not just how much exists -- has become a decisive factor in the productivity of UK research. FAIR-Compute studies allocation in a federated Digital Research Infrastructure (DRI) as a problem at the intersection of algorithmic game theory, transport economics and HPC scheduling. Our central observation is simple: once a shared system must decide who runs, when and under what evidence, its scheduler settings cease to be a purely technical matter and become policy.
  The project combined three strands of evidence: a landscape review of UK and international allocation practice (including EuroHPC, WLCG, ACCESS, JASMIN and DiRAC) supported by a stakeholder survey; a mechanism-design model of allocation under strategic and uncertain user reports; and a simulation study built on the public Fresco/Anvil workload trace and controlled synthetic stress tests. Three results recur across all three strands. First, allocation records measure occupancy (resources reserved) rather than utilisation (useful work done), so the system cannot currently answer the question UKRI and DSIT most want answered -- whether resources deliver productive value. Second, simple, transparent scheduling heuristics perform close to an offline full-information benchmark once tuned, so the near-term opportunity is to tune and instrument existing schedulers rather than replace them. Third, federation is genuinely valuable but behaves like uncoordinated routing when left unmanaged: it can minimise average delay while quietly concentrating load -- and potentially harm -- on the receiving system. This mirrors a classic effect from road-traffic economics (Braess's paradox), where letting everyone independently pick the fastest route can leave the whole network worse off.

</details>


### [464] [A Taxonomy of Performance Metrics for the Distributed Computing Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28407)
*Praveen Kumar Donta,Boris Sedlak,Alfreds Lapkovskis,Alaa Saleh,Ying Li,Victor Casamayor Pujol,Ilir Murturi,Manuel Otero Barbasan,Schahram Dustdar*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向分布式计算连续体系统（DCCS）的性能指标结构化分类法，将指标划分为计算、网络和应用/用户三个层级，同时涵盖可持续性、可观测性、适应性等新兴维度，并提供数学公式及指标采集需求分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着人工智能和大规模数据驱动应用的兴起，计算负载日益分布在资源密集的数据中心与资源受限的边缘环境之间，新型连续体架构和算法不断涌现，迫切需要透明且一致的性能评估方法。然而现有评估实践往往只关注孤立维度（如计算、网络、能效或应用质量），无法提供跨层DCCS行为的全貌视角。

Method: 构建了一个结构化的性能指标分类体系：将指标组织为计算级、网络级和应用/用户级三类，并补充可持续性、可观测性、适应性、数据局部性、迁移感知和连续体碎片化等新兴维度；为各指标提供数学公式，探讨其在异构动态连续体环境中的适用性；同时总结指标采集需求，包括采集范围（单节点/多节点/全系统）、采集阶段和测量方法。

Result: 产出了一套完整的DCCS性能指标分类法，涵盖多层级指标类别、新兴维度、数学化定义以及采集需求框架，能够帮助研究者明确指标是在单一节点、多节点还是全系统层面采集，以及更适合用于运维监控还是实验评估。

Conclusion: 该分类法为DCCS的透明、一致和跨层性能评估提供了系统化的方法论基础，有助于弥合现有评估实践在跨层行为理解上的不足，推动异构动态连续体环境下的标准化评估。

Abstract: Performance evaluation is essential for understanding, comparing, and improving computing systems, including Distributed Computing Continuum Systems (DCCS). In recent years, computational requirements have changed substantially with the growth of artificial intelligence and large-scale data-driven applications. These application tasks are increasingly distributed between resource-intensive data centers and resource-constrained edge environments. In this context, novel computing continuum architectures and algorithms are emerging, creating a need for transparent and consistent performance evaluation. However, existing evaluation practices often focus on isolated dimensions, such as computation, networking, energy efficiency, or application-level quality, and therefore provide only a partial view of cross-layer DCCS behavior. This paper presents a structured taxonomy of performance metrics for DCCS. The taxonomy organizes metrics into computing-level, network-level, and application/user-level categories, while also highlighting emerging dimensions such as sustainability, observability, adaptability, data locality, migration awareness, and continuum fragmentation. Further, we provide mathematical formulations and discuss their relevance to heterogeneous and dynamic continuum environments. We also summarize metric acquisition requirements in terms of acquisition scope, acquisition phase, and measurement method. These requirements help clarify whether a metric can be collected from a single node, multiple nodes, or the full system, and whether it is more suitable for operational monitoring or experimental evaluation.

</details>


### [465] [Safe Quotes for Retroactive Liquidity Pools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28522)
*Peter Bro Miltersen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究恒定乘积流动性池在不同区块链或分片环境下执行非原子性兑换时的报价安全性问题。Aanes等人提出的反事实流动性池（retroactive pool）中，计算安全报价（safe quote）在一般情况下被证明是NP-hard的（除非P=NP，不存在任何固定近似比的近似算法）。然而，作者提出了两个输入依赖的近似比算法，在实践中具有令人满意的效果，从而规避了这一理论障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨链或跨分片的自动化做市商（AMM）中，由于兑换无法原子执行，锁交换（lock-swap）机制需要反事实流动性池来提供价格保证。Aanes等人给出了一种简单算法，但当未解决的提供（provides）和回收（reclaims）流动性同时存在时该算法失效。计算一般情况下的安全报价的计算复杂度是一个开放问题，这对锁交换功能的部署至关重要，因此需要明确其复杂性并寻找可行方案。

Method: 作者首先通过归约证明了在一般情况下计算安全报价（即不超过所有虚拟池中最小可能输出的报价）是NP-hard的，进一步证明除非P=NP，不存在任何固定乘法近似比的多项式时间算法。随后，作者设计了两个输入依赖近似比的实用算法，利用问题求解过程中获得的输入特性来保证近似比，从而在实践中提供足够好的报价。

Result: 理论结果为负面：除非P=NP，不存在多项式时间算法能在一般情况下计算具有任意固定乘法近似比（如50%）的安全报价。但在实践层面，两个提出的算法具有输入依赖的近似比，在典型输入场景下表现良好，为锁交换功能的实际部署提供了可行路径。

Conclusion: 虽然理论上计算精确或固定近似的安全报价在一般情况下是NP-hard的，似乎对锁交换功能的部署构成严重障碍，但作者提出的输入依赖近似比算法能够规避这一障碍，表明该功能在实践中仍然是可行的。

Abstract: Automated market makers exchange assets through liquidity pools whose quoted prices depend on their reserves, with constant product pools being the most common. When such pools reside on different blockchains or shards, a sequence of swaps cannot in general be executed atomically. Aanes et al. introduced lock-swaps and retroactive constant product liquidity pools to provide price guarantees for such a setting. A retroactive pool implicitly maintains a virtual pool for each possible execute/cancel resolution of its active locks. In the presence of active locks, serving a new swap request requires computing a safe quote; a quote with an output that does not exceed the minimum possible output, taken over all virtual pools. The quote being safe is a hard constraint ensuring the integrity of the pool. A soft constraint is to make the quote as close to the minimum possible output as possible. Aanes et al. gave a simple and efficient algorithm for computing the exact minimum when unresolved provides and reclaims of liquidity do not coexist, showed by an explicit example that the algorithm fails in general, and left the computational complexity of the general case open. In this paper, we show that unless P is equal to NP, there is no polynomial time algorithm that computes in the general case a safe quote with any fixed multiplicative approximation ratio (e.g., 50%) relative to the exact minimum. This seems like a severe obstacle for deployment of the lock-swap functionality. However, we also present two simple and practical algorithms for computing safe quotes that have input-dependent approximation ratios that are likely to be satisfactory in practice, thus circumventing that obstacle.

</details>

### [466] [Stimulus-Evoked Network Dynamics in Human Cortical Organoids: From a Graph-Computational Framework to Repeated-Stimulation Depression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28068)
*Esmaeil S. Nadimi,Vinay C. Gogineni,Jan-Matthias Braun,Martin Røssel Larsen,Victoria Blanes-Vidal,Helle Bogetofte Barnkob*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文开发了一个图计算框架来分析人脑类器官的刺激诱发神经活动，发现所谓"刺激诱发传播"实为快速的近同步网络爆发（无外向传播），并首次通过发育匹配的刺激初体验对照组打破纵向研究中的混淆，证明重复刺激会渐进性压抑并空间收缩诱发反应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人脑类器官是研究早期神经环路形成的重要实验模型，但其活动究竟是反映结构化的信息处理还是自发的同步化尚不明确。现有图计算方法常被用于量化刺激诱发的神经传播，但其适用性在类器官这种低试验数、高同步性的数据上从未得到严格检验。

Method: 开发了一套图计算方法框架，包括：刺激条件功能图、作为系统辨识工具的图约束动力学（图神经网络）模型、基于生物信息传递原理的集成深度界定原则，以及一组图级指标。将整个框架应用于来自三个类器官的纵向高密度微电极阵列（HD-MEA）记录，并引入发育匹配、刺激初体验的对照组以打破重复刺激与发育成熟之间的混淆。

Result: 恢复真实采样率和刺激时序后，发现诱发反应是快速的近同步网络爆发，无显著外向传播（峰值潜伏期vs距离斜率为0），因此传播/集成深度指标不适用，且每日连接图在可用试验数下无法可靠估计。改用同步性视角后，发现重复每日刺激会渐进性压抑并空间收缩诱发反应：第7天首次受刺激的类器官激活93%阵列，而接受过5次刺激的类器官仅激活10%。

Conclusion: 类器官中的刺激诱发活动是高度同步的突发反应而非逐级传播，重复刺激显著重塑并压抑网络反应是其真实且可验证的现象，但纵向单臂设计无法区分其与成熟发育效应；作者通过开发匹配的刺激初体验对照打破了这一混淆，为类器官神经活动分析提供了重要的方法学警示。

Abstract: Human cortical organoids provide an experimentally accessible model of early neural circuit formation, yet whether their activity reflects structured information processing rather than spontaneous synchronization is unclear. We developed a graph-computational framework to quantify stimulus-evoked propagation. This includes stimulus-conditioned functional graphs, a graph-constrained dynamical (graph-neural-network) model used as a system-identification tool, a biological message-passing principle bounding integration depth by observable propagation depth, and a suite of graph-level metrics. We carried this program out in full on longitudinal HD-MEA recordings from three organoids. Once the true acquisition sampling rate and stimulus timing were recovered, the evoked response proved to be a fast, near-synchronous network burst with no measurable outward propagation (peak-latency vs. distance slope = 0). The propagation/integration-depth metrics (Deff ,reachability index, dmax) therefore do not apply, and per-day connectivity graphs were not reliably estimable at the available trial count, a negative result with methodological consequences for applying such metrics to organoid data. Reframing around synchrony, response-population size and shared variability revealed a control-validated phenomenon, i.e., repeated daily stimulation progressively depressed and spatially contracted the evoked response. That repeated stimulation reshapes organoid networks is established, but longitudinal designs in which every preparation is stimulated cannot separate this from developmental maturation. We break that confound with a developmentally-matched, stimulation-naive control, where at day 7, an organoid receiving its first-ever stimulation engaged 93% of the array, whereas organoids with five prior sessions engaged 10%.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [467] [Analog Courant Numbers and their Role in Analog Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27609)
*Arash Ghasemi*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文发现了模拟计算（阻抗网络矩阵行）中的动力学约束：最快归一化模式不超过最大行综合单位增益带宽（CUGBW）的2π倍，该界类似Courant数限制，并通过大规模LTspice仿真验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟计算在矩阵运算中具有潜力，但其动态响应速度存在物理限制尚不明确。本文旨在揭示阻抗网络表示矩阵行时，模拟硬件能表示和解析的算子速率存在根本性动力学上限，为模拟计算设计提供理论指导。

Method: 理论推导出CUGBW（行有限增益修正的单位增益带宽加上所有耦合行的贡献，每项为两行单位增益带宽乘积与耦合电导乘积开方，再除以总电导负载乘积开方）；采用CMOS与热离子真空管电路架构，通过大规模LTspice仿真验证，基准电路涵盖一维热方程、图半监督学习和图正则化回归。

Result: 理论界被证明成立：最快归一化模式受限于最大CUGBW的2π倍。该界在多种架构（CMOS到热离子真空管）和多个基准问题上均获验证。

Conclusion: CUGBW界是模拟计算中一个类似Courant数限制的动力学约束，它决定了模拟硬件能够物理表示和解析的算子速率上限，为设计模拟矩阵计算电路提供了关键的设计准则。

Abstract: This paper identifies a dynamical constraint on analog-computing approaches in which a row of the matrix is represented by an impedance network. It shows that the fastest normalized mode is no more than $2π$ times the largest combined unity-gain bandwidth (CUGBW) among all the circuit rows. The CUGBW of a row equals its finite-gain-adjusted unity-gain bandwidth plus the contributions of all rows coupled to it. Each contribution is the square root of the product of the two rows' unity-gain bandwidths multiplied by their coupling conductance and divided by the square root of the product of their total conductance loadings. This bound plays a role analogous to the Courant-number restriction in time-stepping methods by limiting the operator rates that analog hardware can physically represent and resolve at its outputs. The theory is validated using large-scale LTspice simulations across architectures ranging from CMOS to thermionic vacuum-tube circuits. The benchmark circuits implement a one-dimensional heat equation, a graph-based semi-supervised learning problem, and a graph-regularized regression.

</details>


### [468] [GyRot: Leveraging Hidden Synergy between Rotation and Fine-grained Group Quantization for Low-bit LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27694)
*Sangjin Kim,Yuseon Choi,Byeongcheol Kim,Jungjun Oh,Hoi-jun Yoo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: GyRot是一个算法-硬件协同设计的量化框架和加速器，通过"粗粒度旋转+细粒度分组"（CoRFiG）和谐波对齐置换（HAP）技术，弥合了旋转量化与分组量化之间的不匹配，在LLM推理中实现5tate-of-the-art的4-bit精度，同时带来最高3.4倍加速和3.6倍能效提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特量化对高效LLM推理至关重要，旋转量化和细粒度分组量化各自展现潜力，但二者结合时因旋转的全局特性与分组缩放的局部行为不匹配，常导致精度下降或硬件开销增加。现有方法无法有效实现二者的协同集成。

Method: GyRot通过算法-硬件协同设计解决上述问题：1）提出CoRFiG（Coarse Rotation, Fine Grouping），实现旋转与分组量化的合作集成，增强可量化性并放松缩放因子精度要求；2）引入HAP（Harmonic-Aligned Permutation）进一步优化排列；3）重构非对称量化并提出零点取整策略，实现全整数反量化，降低硬件成本；4）在INT4张量PE架构上实现。

Result: 在LLaMA系列模型上取得state-of-the-art的4-bit精度；相比基线LLM加速器，实现最高3.4倍加速和3.6倍能效提升。

Conclusion: GyRot验证了旋转与分组量化的协同集成在实际部署中的有效性，为可扩展、高能效的LLM部署提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Low-bit quantization is essential for efficient LLM inference, and both rotation and fine-grained group quantization have shown individual promise. However, their combination often leads to accuracy degradation or hardware overhead due to a mismatch between the global nature of rotation and the localized behavior of group scaling. We propose GyRot, a quantization framework and hardware accelerator that bridges this gap through algorithm-hardware co-design. GyRot introduces Coarse Rotation, Fine Grouping (CoRFiG) and Harmonic-Aligned Permutation (HAP) to enable cooperative integration of rotation and group quantization, enhancing quantizability while relaxing scaling factor precision. To further reduce hardware cost, we reformulate asymmetric quantization and introduce a zero-point rounding strategy that enables fully integer dequantization. Implemented on an INT4-based tensor PE architecture, GyRot achieves state-of-the-art 4-bit accuracy across LLaMA-family models, while delivering up to 3.4x speedup and 3.6x energy efficiency over baseline LLM accelerators. These results validate GyRot's practical effectiveness for scalable and energy-efficient LLM deployment.

</details>


### [469] [LightRot: A Light-Weighted Rotation Scheme and Architecture for Accurate Low-Bit Large Language Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27704)
*Sangjin Kim,Yuseon Choi,Jungjun Oh,Byeongcheol Kim,Hoi-Jun Yoo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出LightRot，一种面向低比特大语言模型推理的轻量级旋转方案及专用硬件加速器，通过分组局部旋转（GLR）和离群方向对齐（ODA）算法结合基于快速哈达玛变换（FHT）的分层旋转单元，在28nm CMOS工艺下实现了4-bit推理27.4 TOPS/W的峰值能效，并在LLaMA2-13B和LLaMA3-8B等先进模型上验证了性能，同时在MT-Bench基准上展示了其在真实对话场景中的实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型在多个领域展现出卓越能力，实现高能效且准确的推理变得越来越关键。低比特量化虽然能降低计算开销，但旋转操作的能耗开销是主要瓶颈，且现有方案通常依赖更高精度推理或仅在GPT-2等基础语言建模任务上评估。因此需要一种既能解决旋转能耗问题，又能适用于先进大模型（如LLaMA系列）的高效低比特推理方案。

Method: LightRot架构整合了两项核心算法——分组局部旋转（GLR）和离群方向对齐（ODA），并采用基于快速哈达玛变换（FHT）的分层旋转单元来降低旋转能耗。该设计将算法创新与硬件加速器架构相结合，针对低比特LLM推理中的关键挑战进行优化。

Result: 在28nm CMOS工艺下实现的加速器在4-bit推理中达到27.4 TOPS/W的峰值能效，超越现有最先进设计。性能在LLaMA2-13B和LLaMA3-8B等先进模型上得到验证，并通过MT-Bench基准展示了在真实对话场景中的鲁棒适用性。

Conclusion: LightRot通过算法创新与硬件效率的协同，为可扩展的低比特LLM推理树立了新范式，为可持续AI发展铺平了道路。该工作重新定义了基于聊天的AI系统的评估基准。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to demonstrate exceptional capabilities across various domains, the challenge of achieving energy-efficient and accurate inference becomes increasingly critical. This work presents LightRot, a lightweight rotation scheme and dedicated hardware accelerator designed for low-bit LLM inference. The proposed architecture integrates Grouped Local Rotation (GLR) and Outlier Direction Aligning (ODA) algorithms with a hierarchical Fast Hadamard Transform (FHT)-based rotation unit to address key challenges in low-bit quantization, including the energy overhead of rotation operations. The proposed accelerator, implemented in a 28nm CMOS process, achieves a peak energy efficiency of 27.4 TOPS/W for 4-bit inference, surpassing prior state-of-the-art designs. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on higher-precision inference or evaluate on basic language modeling tasks like GPT-2, LightRot is optimized for advanced models such as LLaMA2-13B and LLaMA3-8B. Its performance is further validated on MT-Bench, demonstrating robust applicability to real-world conversational scenarios and redefining benchmarks for chat-based AI systems. By synergizing algorithmic innovations and hardware efficiency, this work sets a new paradigm for scalable, low-bit LLM inference, paving the way for sustainable AI advancements.

</details>


### [470] [ARES: Adaptive Reasoning-Effort Steering for PPA- and Cost-Aware RTL Optimization with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27879)
*Stef Cuyckens,Mihaela Jivanescu,Jun Yin,Chao Fang,Marian Verhelst*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Ares是一种针对LLM驱动的RTL设计PPA优化的智能体，通过引入归一化美元成本、发现长期记忆设计无关紧要、并采用自适应推理努力策略（耐心计数器），在等成本下显著降低FOM，超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在优化RTL设计PPA时存在三个问题：报告质量时未归一化成本导致不公平比较；将性能归因于工程化跨设计记忆但缺乏可靠的证据；所有迭代保持固定推理努力，导致推理资源分配不合理。

Method: Ares包含三项创新：(1) 提出每次LLM调用的归一化美元成本，与品质因数(FoM)一并报告，以实现跨努力水平和优化器的公平比较；(2) 通过该核算体系发现，长期记忆的工程设计影响甚微，工程记忆相比直接拼接经验并无可靠优势；(3) 采用自适应推理努力策略，仅在低努力级别进展停滞时升级到更深推理，通过21个训练设计的耐心计数器来配置，将推理资源分配给有回报的地方而非均匀分配。

Result: 在三个未见过的测试设计上，努力策略将FoM降低23-27%，而最佳固定努力仅达到16-23%，且归一化成本相同。Ares在等成本下相比最佳固定努力策略提升了约4-11%的FoM。Ares还弥合了LLM起草的乘累加单元与其高度手工优化版本之间最多83%的差距，并以Dr. RTL的12%的token消耗达到比其深25%的FoM。

Conclusion: Ares证明在RTL PPA优化中，自适应分配推理努力比精心设计的跨设计记忆更为关键，通过成本归一化的核算框架和耐心计数驱动的努力升级策略，能以显著更低的成本实现更优的PPA优化效果。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents optimize the power, performance, and area (PPA) of register-transfer-level (RTL) designs by iterating over edits, synthesis, and PPA analysis, paying a dollar cost for every LLM call. Prior agents report the quality reached without its normalized cost, attribute that quality to an engineered cross-design memory, and hold the reasoning effort of every call fixed. We propose Ares with three corresponding innovations. (1) We introduce a normalized dollar cost per LLM call reported alongside the figure of merit (FoM), enabling fair comparison across effort levels and optimizers. (2) Using this accounting, we find the construction of the long-term memory matters little. An engineered memory brings no dependable gain over a plain concatenation of the same experience. (3) We instead adapt the per-call reasoning effort by escalating to deeper reasoning only once progress at a lower effort stalls, via a patience counter fit on 21 training designs, allocating reasoning where it pays rather than uniformly across all iterations. On three test designs unseen during training, the effort policy lowers the FoM by 23-27% where the best fixed effort reaches 16-23%, at equal normalized cost. Ares closes up to 83% of the gap from an LLM-drafted multiply-accumulate unit to its highly hand-optimized counterpart, and reaches a 25% deeper FoM than state-of-the-art Dr. RTL at 12% of its tokens.

</details>


### [471] [Demystifying DRAM Read Disturbance: Bridging the Gap Between Experimental Characterization and Device-Level Modeling of RowHammer and RowPress Phenomena](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28233)
*Haocong Luo,Longda Zhou,Ataberk Olgun,İsmail Emir Yüksel,Nisa Bostanci,Zhigang Ji,Xing Wu,Onur Mutlu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文旨在弥合DRAM读取干扰（RowHammer和RowPress）实验表征与器件级建模之间的差距，通过识别现有器件模型中三个关键指标（位翻转方向、位翻转次数、ACmin）与实验观测之间的不一致性，并使用TCAD仿真来验证和更新器件级误差机制，为未来DRAM读取干扰的理解、表征和缓解提供原则性基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DRAM读取干扰（如RowHammer和RowPress）是严重的可靠性问题，会导致未访问的DRAM位置发生意外位翻转，严重影响基于DRAM的计算系统的安全性、可靠性和安全性。然而，现有器件级物理机制模型无法完全解释所有主要的实验观测结果，且实验表征和器件级建模之间存在明显鸿沟，缺乏统一的理论基础。

Method: 本文首先识别并论证现有器件级模型中RowHammer和RowPress物理机制与实验表征结果之间的差距和不一致性，重点关注三个映射到一阶物理机制的基本指标：1）位翻转方向、2）位翻转次数、3）触发首次位翻转的最小攻击行激活次数（ACmin）。其次，进行一套全面且严格的TCAD仿真，以匹配实验表征中观测到的RowHammer和RowPress位翻转现象。

Result: 基于研究结果，本文总结了更新的器件级误差机制以理解RowHammer和RowPress位翻转，并识别了显著影响仿真结果是否与真实芯片表征匹配的关键建模和仿真参数。

Conclusion: 本文讨论了对严谨、全面且高效的DRAM读取干扰位翻转实验表征方法论的影响，以及对DRAM读取干扰缓解技术设计的影响，为未来相关工作提供了原则性基础。

Abstract: DRAM read disturbance, like RowHammer and RowPress, is a critical robustness issue where accessing DRAM can cause unintended bitflips in other unaccessed DRAM locations. DRAM read disturbance bitflips significantly impact the safe, secure, and reliable operation of DRAM-based computing systems. Many prior works experimentally characterize these bitflips and propose mitigations based on empirical results. Other device-level works study their underlying physical mechanisms, but these mechanisms do not fully explain all major empirical observations.
  Our goal is to bridge the gap between experimental characterization and device-level modeling and understanding of RowHammer and RowPress, providing a principled foundation for future work on understanding, characterizing, and mitigating DRAM read disturbance. We first identify and demonstrate gaps and inconsistencies between the physical mechanisms of RowHammer and RowPress described by existing device-level models and experimental characterization of their bitflips. We focus on three fundamental metrics that should map to first-order physical mechanisms: 1) bitflip directions, 2) bitflip counts, and 3) the minimum number of aggressor row activations that trigger the first bitflips (i.e., ACmin). Second, we present a comprehensive and rigorous set of TCAD simulations that match phenomena observed in experimental characterizations of RowHammer and RowPress bitflips.
  From our results, we 1) summarize updated device-level error mechanisms for understanding RowHammer and RowPress bitflips, and 2) identify key modeling and simulation parameters that significantly affect whether simulation results match real-chip characterization. We discuss implications for 1) rigorous, comprehensive, and efficient experimental characterization methodologies of DRAM read disturbance bitflips, and 2) the design of DRAM read disturbance mitigation techniques.

</details>

### [472] [PlantBGC: Transformer for Plant BGC Discovery via Label-Free Domain Adaptation and Weak Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27258)
*Yuhan Zhao,Nidhi Grover,Zhishan Guo,Ning Sui*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: PlantBGC是一种将植物基因组表示为有序Pfam结构域序列、用编码器Transformer在微生物BGC数据上预训练并通过无标签掩码语言建模适应植物基因组的BGC挖掘工具，显著提升了植物BGC预测的召回率和边界完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 植物生物合成基因簇(BGC)的监督标注稀缺，现有工具多基于签名和规则，未能充分利用上下文表示学习的最新进展，也难以在强域偏移下控制假阳性。作者希望建立AI辅助工作流，将微生物BGC的标注知识迁移到植物基因组，缩小实验搜索空间。

Method: PlantBGC将基因组表示为有序Pfam结构域序列，使用编码器-only Transformer在MIBiG微生物BGC上训练以学习BGC相似性，随后通过无标签掩码语言建模(MLM)适应植物基因组。同时引入GO/KEGG派生的弱监督信号来降低假阳性。

Result: 微生物基准上，token级AUC在10折交叉验证下为0.988，留类验证下为0.979。在34个植物已标注位点上，严格100%覆盖条件下已知BGC恢复率从29.4%提升至67.6%。GO弱监督使代理初级样比率降低48.40%，KEGG降低45.20%（配对Wilcoxon p=1.53e-5）。与plantiSMASH相比，匹配区域上中位长度比为0.278，93.8%的预测簇更紧凑。

Conclusion: PlantBGC证明了从微生物BGC到植物的监督迁移结合标记自由MLM适应是有效的，能够显著提升植物BGC边界预测的准确性和紧凑性，为植物天然产物途径的基因挖掘提供了可靠的计算辅助手段。

Abstract: Plant biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) encode specialized-metabolite pathways, yet curated plant BGC labels remain scarce, hindering supervised discovery at genome scale. Existing plant BGC mining tools are largely signature- and rule-driven and do not fully leverage recent advances in contextual representation learning for modeling long-range domain context and controlling false positives under strong domain shift. We seek an AI-assisted workflow that narrows experimental search space by transferring supervision from well-annotated microbial BGCs to plant genomes. We present PlantBGC, representing genomes as ordered Pfam-domain sequences and learning BGC-likeness with an encoder-only Transformer trained on MIBiG microbial BGCs and adapted to plants via label-free masked language modeling. On microbial benchmarks, PlantBGC achieves token-level AUC = 0.988 (10-fold CV) and 0.979 (leave-class-out). On plants, adaptation improves known-BGC recovery on n = 34 curated loci under strict 100% coverage, increasing recovery from 29.4% to 67.6% and indicating more complete boundaries. GO/KEGG-derived weak supervision reduces proxy primary-like ratio by 48.40% (GO) and 45.20% (KEGG), with consistent per-species reductions (paired Wilcoxon p = 1.53e-5). Compared to plantiSMASH, PlantBGC yields more compact loci on matched regions (median length ratio = 0.278; 93.8% of pairs are shorter).

</details>
